get.description:
To retrieve appointment records from your Zoho CRM organization. 

Use the `page` and `per_page` parameters to paginate up to 2,000 records, or use the `page_token` received in a prior response to paginate beyond 2,000 records up to a maximum of 100,000. Each request returns a maximum of 200 records. 

Subform data is not included when retrieving multiple appointments. The API returns field values containing sensitive health data only when the Restrict Data access through API option is disabled in compliance settings.

200.description: Returns the list of appointment records that match the request criteria.

**Resolution:** The module API name in the request URL must be `Appointments__s`, and the request must use the GET method.

delete.summary: Delete one or more appointment records
delete.description: To delete one or more appointment records in your Zoho CRM organization. Note that this API will not delete any deals created on the completion of the deleted appointments.

The **details** object identifies the invalid field at **json_path** `$.data[0].Appointment_For.module.api_name`.

data.message: the given module name is not exist in multimodulelookup

DependentFieldMissingResponse2.summary: DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error when Status is not Cancelled but cancellation fields are set.
DependentFieldMissingResponse2.description: Illustrates a **DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING** error returned when cancellation fields such as **Cancellation_Reason** are provided but the appointment **Status** is not set to **Cancelled**. The **Status** field must be set to **Cancelled** before cancellation information fields can be updated.

data.message: To Update the fields of Cancellation Information Section, value of Status should be Cancelled

NotAllowedResponse3.summary: **NOT_ALLOWED** error when completing an appointment without a job sheet.
NotAllowedResponse3.description:
Illustrates the **NOT_ALLOWED** error returned when the **Status** field is set to completed but no job sheet has been created for the appointment. 

The response message confirms that the appointment cannot be marked as completed without creating the jobsheet, with the violating field identified at `$.data[0].Status`.

data.message: Appointment cannot be marked as completed without creating the jobsheet

DependentMismatchResponse2.summary: **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** error when **Status** set to Completed before appointment ends.
DependentMismatchResponse2.description:
Illustrates a **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** error returned when **Status** is set to Completed before the **Appointment_Start_Time** end threshold has passed. 

The API rejects the transition to prevent premature completion of an active appointment.

data.message: Appointment cannot be marked as completed before the appointment ends

DependentMismatchResponse3.summary: **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** error when **Job_Sheet_Name__s** set on a non-completed appointment.
DependentMismatchResponse3.description:
Illustrates a **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** error returned when **Job_Sheet_Name__s** is provided for an appointment whose **Status** is not yet Completed. 

The API enforces that job sheets may only be created once an appointment reaches the Completed status.

data.message: Job Sheet can be created only for completed appointment

DependentMismatchResponse4.summary: **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** error when **Status** set to Overdue before appointment ends.
DependentMismatchResponse4.description:
Illustrates a **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** error returned when **Status** is set to Overdue before the **Appointment_Start_Time** end threshold has passed. 

The API rejects the transition to prevent premature overdue marking of an active appointment.

data.message: Appointment cannot be marked as overdue before the appointment ends

DependentMismatchResponse5.summary: **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** error when **Status** set to Scheduled with a past **Appointment_Start_Time**
DependentMismatchResponse5.description: Illustrates a **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** error returned when **Status** is set to Scheduled but **Appointment_Start_Time** falls in the past. The API rejects scheduling requests that reference past dates to preserve appointment integrity.

data.message: Appointment cannot be scheduled for past dates

MandatoryNotFoundResponse2.summary: **MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND** error when the **unit** key is missing from a **Remind_At** object.
MandatoryNotFoundResponse2.description:
Illustrates the **MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND** error returned when the **unit** key is missing from a **Remind_At** reminder object in the request. 

The response identifies the absent field via **api_name** and its expected location at `$.data[0].Remind_At[0].unit`.

InvalidDataResponse3.summary: **INVALID_DATA** error is thrown when the  **appointmentId** path parameter does not match a valid appointment record.

InvalidDataResponse4.summary: **INVALID_DATA** error  when the **Status** field value fails validation.

InvalidDataResponse5.summary: **INVALID_DATA** error when **unit** field in **Remind_At** receives a non-integer value.

RecordLockedResponse1.summary: **RECORD_LOCKED** error when the appointment record is locked and cannot be modified.
RecordLockedResponse1.description: Illustrates a **RECORD_LOCKED** error returned when an attempt is made to update an appointment whose record has been locked via the **record_locking** action. InvalidDataMaxLengthResponse1.summary: **INVALID_DATA** error when maximum length exceeded for the **data** field.

post.description: To bundle multiple Zoho CRM API requests into a single HTTP call, reducing network round-trips and enabling request chaining. You can reference the output of one sub-request in another using the format **@{sub_request_id:JSONPath}** to build dependent workflows. When **rollback_on_fail** is enabled, all successful sub-requests are rolled back if any subsequent sub-request fails.

Locked actions require the appropriate privilege, and read-only actions cannot be modified. For single-value fields, use a string for value. post.description: To upload one or more files to the Zoho File System (ZFS) in your Zoho CRM account. The API returns an encrypted file ID for each uploaded file, which you can use to attach the file to a file upload field, image upload field, or record image field through the Create or Update Records API. The file is uploaded using multipart/form-data with a required 'file' field containing the binary data of the file to be uploaded. The response includes the file ID, name, status, and other details. Can upload 10 files in a single request by repeating the 'file' field. Maximum file size is 20 MB.

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: Specify the upload type for inline images. Possible values: **inline** - Upload the file as an inline image for use in email templates or rich-text fields.

400.description: The file upload request is malformed or invalid.Bad Request - The file upload request is malformed or invalid. Returns `failure_in_attachment_handling` when the 'file' field is missing or contains no file data. Returns `INVALID_REQUEST` when request constraints are violated, such as exceeding the 10-file limit per request. **Resolution:** Verify that the request includes a **file** field with valid binary file data in multipart/form-data format, and that the request does not exceed ten files.

get.description: To retrieve the binary content of a file stored in Zoho File System (ZFS) using its unique file ID. The file ID is provided as a required query parameter 'id'. If the file exists, the API returns the file's binary data along with appropriate headers indicating the MIME type and content disposition for download. If the file ID does not correspond to any file in ZFS, a 204 No Content response is returned. This endpoint is used to download files that have been previously uploaded to ZFS and associated with Zoho CRM records.

This occurs when the 'id' parameter contains an invalid file identifier, an empty string, or references a file that has been deleted or never existed. **Resolution:** Verify that the **id** parameter contains a valid encrypted file ID from a previous upload response.

post.description:
To retrieve the count of related records for a specified parent record in your Zoho CRM organization. Supports optional filtering by approval status, conversion status, category type, and field-level equality criteria. A single request can include up to 20 related list count specifications. You can use this API to get the count of records in the following types of related lists:

- **System-defined related lists**, such as:
  - Survey
  - Desk
  - Projects
  - Visits
  - Expense
  - Invoice
  - Subscription
- **Custom related lists** created via Lookup fields.
- **Custom related lists** created via Multi-select Lookup fields.
- **Custom related lists** created via Multi-module Lookup fields.
- **Related lists** created when history tracking is enabled for a picklist field.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain a **get_related_records_count** array. You can include a maximum of 20 objects per request. Use the [Get Related Records API](related_records.yaml#$.paths./{parentRecordModule}/{parentRecord}/{relatedList}.get) to get the ID of the related list in the key ID.

To retrieve the details of a specific layout by its layout ID for a specified module in your Zoho CRM account.  **Important Notes:** - The `profiles` array is `null` when the user does not have "Module Customization" permission in their profile. - For Deals module: When the pipeline feature is enabled, multiple layouts exist per pipeline. Each pipeline can have its own set of layouts. - The `mode` parameter filters the layout by mode. Possible values: **all**, **business_card**, **quick_create**. - Score and Visit Summary sections are system-generated and read-only.  **Prerequisite:** The layout ID can be obtained from the Get All Layouts API.

patch.description: To update a custom layout in your Zoho CRM organization, including renaming it, modifying profile permissions, enabling or disabling the business card display, and creating, updating, or deleting sections and fields within sections.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain a layouts array with one object. You can include a maximum of five sections per request, with no more than five fields in total across all sections.

RenameLayout.description: Demonstrates renaming a custom layout by supplying a new name value in the request body. The existing layout identified by the path parameter retains all other configuration; only the display name changes.

AddProfilePermission.summary: Granting a CRM profile access to a layout
AddProfilePermission.description: Shows a layout update request that grants a CRM profile access to the specified layout. The profile is associated with the layout so that users assigned to that profile can view and interact with it when working on records.

RemoveProfilePermission.summary: Revokes a CRM profile's access to a layout via the delete flag
RemoveProfilePermission.description: Demonstrates revoking a CRM profile's access to a layout by setting the delete flag on the profile entry. This removes the profile's visibility and usage rights for the layout without affecting other profiles assigned to it.

ToggleBusinessCard.summary: Toggle the business card display setting on a layout
ToggleBusinessCard.description: Illustrates toggling the business card display setting on a layout by setting the business card display property to the desired Boolean state. All other layout properties remain unchanged while only the business card visibility is modified.

CreateCustomSection.summary: Creating a new custom section within a layout
CreateCustomSection.description: Shows a layout update request that introduces a new custom section into the layout structure. The section is defined with a name and display configuration, providing a dedicated grouping area for fields within the layout.

AddFieldToSection.summary: Adding an existing field to a layout section
AddFieldToSection.description: Shows a layout update request that places an existing CRM field into a designated section. The field is referenced by its identifier and positioned within the section's field sequence without creating a new field definition.

UpdateFieldSequence.summary: Reorder a field's position within a layout section
UpdateFieldSequence.description: Shows how to reorder a field within its section by specifying the target field identifier alongside a new sequence or position value. The updated ordering is applied to the named section without altering any other field configuration.

DeleteSection.summary: Permanently removes a section and its field assignments from a layout
DeleteSection.description: Demonstrates permanently removing an entire section from a layout. Unlike moving fields to unused, this operation irreversibly eliminates the section and all of its field assignments from the layout.

MoveFieldToUnused.summary: Relocates a field to the unused items section without deleting it
MoveFieldToUnused.description: Demonstrates relocating a field to the unused items section of a layout without permanently deleting it. The field is preserved and can be reassigned to an active section at a later time.

CreateNewField.summary: Adds a new custom field definition to a layout section
CreateNewField.description: Demonstrates adding a new custom field definition to an existing section of a layout. The request specifies the field type, label, and target section, creating a field that did not previously exist in the layout.

MultipleFieldsAcrossSections.summary: Adds up to five fields spread across multiple layout sections in one request
MultipleFieldsAcrossSections.description: Demonstrates adding up to five fields distributed across two or more distinct layout sections within a single request. This approach reduces round-trips when populating several sections simultaneously, subject to the five-field-per-request limit.

CreateFieldWithAssociation.summary: Creating a new field with a Field-Of-Lookup association
CreateFieldWithAssociation.description: Shows a layout update request that creates a new field inline and establishes a Field-Of-Lookup (FOL) mapping to a related field in another module. This association allows the field to surface data from a linked record via an existing lookup field, connecting the two modules at the field level.

UpdateFieldWithAssociation.summary: Attach a Field-Of-Lookup association to an existing layout field
UpdateFieldWithAssociation.description: Demonstrates attaching a Field-Of-Lookup (FOL) association to an existing layout field by providing the field identifier together with association details that reference the lookup field and its related field. This pattern links two fields so that the layout can derive values from the specified lookup relationship.

AddMirrorComponentToSection.summary: Adding a mirror field component to a layout section
AddMirrorComponentToSection.description: Shows a layout update request that adds a mirror field component to a section. A mirror component reflects the value of a field from a related module, allowing users to view cross-module data directly within the layout.

200.description: Returns a layouts array containing the result of the update operation, including a SUCCESS status code and the ID of the updated layout.

To create a field dependency between a parent picklist field and a child picklist field for a specific layout in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Prerequisites**

- The selected layout must contain at least two option-based fields.
- Supported field types are Picklist, Radio Button, and Multi-select Picklist.
- Multi-select Picklist fields can be used only as child fields.
- Parent and child fields must belong to the selected layout.

post.description: To bulk update the ownership of records in a specified module based on a Custom View, territory, or field-based criteria in your Zoho CRM organization. post.description: To update a specific field value across multiple records of a module in your Zoho CRM organization in a single API call. The operation supports two modes. In the non-scheduler mode, the caller supplies a list of record IDs in the `ids` array and the system updates those records synchronously, with a maximum of 500 records per request. In the scheduler mode, the caller supplies a Custom View ID in `cvid` and the request schedules an asynchronous background job that processes up to 50,000 records matching the view; the response returns a `job_id` that can be passed to the corresponding GET endpoint to track the job's progress. The Deals module accepts up to three fields per request; all other supported modules accept only one field per request. Email, lookup, multi-line, layout, and line item fields cannot be mass updated.

requestBody.description:
The request body contains the data required to perform the operation.


Mass update of records happens in two ways:


**Scheduler type**: When you specify a custom view ID and territory
ID, a job is scheduled in the background and the system returns a
"job_id". Use this job_id in the [Get Mass Update Status
API](mass_update.yaml#$.paths./{module}/actions/mass_update.get) to
get the status of the job. You can update a maximum of **50,000
records** in this type.


**Non-scheduler type**: When you specify the record IDs, system
updates the records instantly. You can update a maximum of **500
records** in a single API call in this type of mass update.

BasicFieldUpdate.description: Illustrates a synchronous mass update that sets the `Venue` field to `Zylker` on the two records identified by their IDs in the `ids` array.

NestedObjectUpdate.description: Illustrates a synchronous mass update that sets multiple fields on a single record, including a `Layout` field whose value is provided as an object with `id` and `display_label`.

CvidUpdate.description: Illustrates a scheduler-type request that mass updates the `Age` field on all records matching the provided Custom View ID.

NonSubordinateUser.summary: An example of non-subordinate user assigned to a user lookup field.
NonSubordinateUser.description:
Illustrates a per-record error returned when a user assigned
to a user lookup field is not eligible under the calling
user's hierarchy permissions.


This error can occur in the following cases:


- **Role hierarchy permission: List Subordinates Only**

The calling user can assign only users who are their
subordinates in the role hierarchy.

- **Territory hierarchy permission: Territories and
Sub-Territory Users Only**

The calling user can assign only users who belong to their
territory or its sub-territories.

For example, consider the following territory hierarchy:
    - Root Territory
        - Territory A (User1, User2)
             - Territory B (User3, User4)
        - Territory C (User5, User6)
A user in Territory A can assign users from Territory A and
Territory B, but cannot assign users from Territory C.

get.summary: Get records from a specified module
get.description: Retrieves records from the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. Use "sort_by" and "sort_order" to control the sorting of records. To fetch up to 2000 records, use "page" (1-10) and "per_page" (maximum 200). To fetch more than 2000 records, use the "page_token" returned in the response. Consecutive page tokens can be used to navigate through up to 100,000 records. The "$has_more" key is returned when fetching a specific record and indicates whether more records are available in subforms, multi-select lookup fields, and multi-user lookup fields. To retrieve details of a related list, use the [Get Related Records API](related_records.yaml#$.paths./{parentRecordModule}/{parentRecord}/{relatedList}.get).

post.description: Creates one or more records in the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API name. Use the [Get Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) to retrieve the available field API names and data types. You can create up to 100 records in a single API call. requestBody.description: To insert a single record, send only one JSON object in the input with the necessary keys and values. Duplicates are checked for every insert record API call based on unique fields. A maximum of 100 records can be inserted per API call. You must use only Field API names in the input. You can obtain the field API names from the [Fields metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) Choose "Fields" from the "Filter By" drop-down. In the Calls module, the call duration for an Inbound or Outbound call cannot be zero. For any module, specify all the mandatory fields while creating a record. When inserting multiple records, the Response JSON array maintains the same order as the input records, allowing each response to be mapped to its respective input record. In case of partial success or failure, the API returns an HTTP status 207 (Multi-Status), where individual record-level success or error details are provided within the response array in the same order. You must provide the layout ID field if you want to, include the layout specific mandatory fields in the API-level mandatory check. Include only the fields that are defined in your layout for API-level processing and ignore the rest.

put.summary: Update records in a specified module
put.description:
Updates one or more existing records in the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API name and the [Get Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) to retrieve the field API names.
A maximum of 100 records can be updated per API call. Use only Field API names in the input. You can update all fields supported by the Insert Records API operation.
When updating multiple records, the response array maintains the same order as the input records, allowing each response to be mapped to its corresponding input record. 
To update multiple subform records, specify the subform API name as a key within the record and provide the subform records as a JSON array. Use the subform field API names as keys within each subform record. For detailed information on subforms, refer to the [Manipulating Subform using Zoho CRM APIs](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/community/topic/kaizen-124-accessing-subform-using-zoho-crm-apis).
Use the [Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) and [Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) to retrieve the API names of the subform and its fields. To update an existing subform record, include its record ID in the subform JSON array. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) with the subform API name to retrieve subform record IDs.
When adding a new subform record, it is appended to the existing records. Passing an empty JSON array for a subform deletes all its records. To delete a specific subform record, specify its record ID and set "_delete" to "null". Deleting the parent record also deletes all its subform records.

post.summary: Create or update records in a specified module
post.description:
The Upsert API inserts a new record or updates an existing record based on duplicate check field values. If a matching record is found, it is updated; otherwise, a new record is inserted.
When using the Upsert API, the system checks for duplicate records based on the duplicate check fields. There are two types of duplicate check fields: system-defined duplicate check fields and user-defined unique fields.
System-defined duplicate check fields are predefined unique fields for each module. The system automatically checks these fields to prevent duplicate records. Refer to the System-defined Duplicate Check Fields section for module-specific details.
User-defined unique fields are fields for which the "Do not allow duplicate values" option is enabled. These fields allow users to define custom fields for duplicate checking. For more information, refer to [Mark a Field as Unique](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/crm/customize-crm-account/customizing-fields/articles/use-custom-fields#Mark_a_Field_as_Unique). When a record is upserted, the system first checks for duplicates in these fields. If a matching record exists, it gets updated; otherwise, a new record is inserted.
You can specify the order in which the system checks for duplicate records using the "duplicate_check_fields" array in the API request. The array can contain system-defined duplicate check fields, such as "Email" for the Leads module, and user-defined unique fields, such as "Phone" and "Fax".
For example, in the Leads module, you can specify: "duplicate_check_fields": ["Email", "Phone", "Fax"].
If "duplicate_check_fields" is not specified, the system checks duplicate records in the following order: 1. System-defined duplicate check fields. 2. User-defined unique fields.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain a **data** array. You can include a maximum of 100 objects per request. You must use only Field API names in the input; obtain them from the [Get Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get). The "INVALID_DATA" error is returned if a field value exceeds the maximum length defined for that field. For example, if a Text field has a maximum length of 10 characters, the API cannot accept a value such as "12345678901", since it contains 11 characters. Records with subform details can also be inserted or updated through this API. Provide the layout ID to include layout-specific mandatory fields in the API-level mandatory field check; only the fields defined in that layout are considered for processing, and the rest are ignored.

get.description:
To retrieve the total number of records in a specified Zoho CRM module, optionally filtered by a Custom View or search criteria. The count can be filtered using `cvid` (Custom View ID) or search parameters (`criteria`, `email`, `phone`, or `word`). These two filter groups are mutually exclusive - they cannot be combined in the same request. The `converted` and `approved` parameters apply only to the Leads module. The `type` parameter applies only to the Users module. Note: The record count may take 1-10 minutes to reflect the latest changes in Zoho CRM.

The count can be filtered using `cvid` (Custom View ID) or one of the search parameters (`criteria`, `phone`, `email`, `word`).

**Important Constraint (Zoho Documentation):**

You can only include **either** `cvid` **or** one of the search parameters (`criteria`, `phone`, `email`, `word`) in a single request. Combining `cvid` with any search parameter will result in an `AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING` error (HTTP 400).

get.description: To retrieve a paginated list of records currently present in the Recycle Bin in your Zoho CRM account. The response contains up to 200 records per page, along with pagination metadata. The list can be filtered by display name, source module, the user who deleted the records, or the deletion timestamp. Sorting is supported by display name, deletion time, or deleted-by user in ascending or descending order.

200.description: Returns a paginated list of recycle-bin records that match the request, along with pagination metadata such as the current page, page size, and whether more records are available.

RecycleBinListSample.description: Shows a representative list response with one deleted record and pagination metadata indicating page size, current page, count, and whether more records are available.

204.description: Indicates that the request succeeded but no recycle-bin records were found. The response body is empty.

delete.description: To permanently delete one or more records from the Recycle Bin in your Zoho CRM account. When deleting a parent record, Zoho CRM also removes all its associated child records from the Recycle Bin, such as Notes and Attachments. When the total number of records to delete is 1000 or fewer, the operation completes immediately and returns a 200 response with per-item results. When the total exceeds 1000, the deletion runs as a background job and returns a 202 response. Partial successes return a 207 multi-status response with individual success and error entries per record.

200.description: Returns the per-item results for each recycle-bin record that Zoho CRM permanently removes. The **recycle_bin** array contains one entry per processed record, each with the deletion status, result code, message, and the affected record ID.

202.description: Indicates that the deletion has been accepted and scheduled as a background job. Zoho CRM returns this response when the total number of records to delete, including child records such as Notes and Attachments, exceeds 1000, or when the **filters** parameter is used.

recycle_bin.message: record has been scheduled for deletion

post.description: To restore one or more deleted records from the Recycle Bin in your Zoho CRM account. Supply the scope of restoration in the request body using exactly one of three options: **ids** to restore specific records, **filters** to restore records matching field-based criteria, or **restore_all_records** to restore every record currently in the Recycle Bin. When restoring a parent record, Zoho CRM also restores all its associated child records, such as Notes and Attachments. If the total number of records to restore, including child records, is 1000 or fewer, the operation completes immediately. When the total exceeds 1000, when the **filters** option is applied, or when **restore_all_records** is **true**, the restoration runs as a background job. Admin users can restore any record; non-admin users can restore only the records they own unless their profile grants broader access.

200.description: Returns per-item results when records are restored immediately. The **recycle_bin** array contains one entry per processed record with the operation status, code, message, and the restored record ID.

202.description: Indicates that the restoration has been accepted and scheduled as a background job. Zoho CRM returns this response when the total number of records to restore, including child records, exceeds 1000, when the **filters** option is applied, or when **restore_all_records** is set to **true**.

Success207.description: Shows the multi-status response returned when a batch request partially succeeds: the API creates the first record and assigns a new ID, while rejecting the second record with an INVALID_DATA error indicating that the Duration value falls outside the permitted range.

400.description:
The request could not be processed because one or more service records contain invalid data, fail a field-level validation check, or violate a service-availability constraint.

**Resolution:** The caller must inspect each error item to identify the offending field, correct the request payload accordingly, and resubmit the request.

InvalidDataResponse1.summary: Availability_Type value rejected as not a valid picklist entry.
InvalidDataResponse1.description: Shows an error returned when the value supplied for Availability_Type is not a recognised picklist option. The API responds with code INVALID_DATA, identifying the field and indicating that only predefined picklist values are accepted.

data.message: The given Availability Type is not in picklist

DependentMismatchResponse1.summary: Dependent mismatch error when Available_Days conflict with business days.
DependentMismatchResponse1.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Available_Days values do not align with the business days defined by the Availability_Type field. The API rejects the request with a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error indicating that Available_Days must be a subset of the configured business days.

data.message: The given Available Days are not there in business days

DependentMismatchResponse2.summary: Dependent mismatch where Available_Timings value does not satisfy business timing constraints.
DependentMismatchResponse2.description:
Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the service's Available_Timings fall outside the configured business hours while the Status is Available. 

The API rejects the request because the service availability window must align with the organisation's business timing configuration.

data.message: Service available time does not satisfy the business timing

InvalidDataResponse2.summary: Available_Dates contains a value in an invalid date format.
InvalidDataResponse2.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Available_Dates field contains a value that does not conform to the required YYYY-MM-DD date format. The API rejects the request with an invalid data message.

InvalidDataResponse3.summary: Invalid data when duration value is outside allowed range.
InvalidDataResponse3.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Duration field contains a value outside the permitted range of five minutes to 24 hours. The API rejects the request with a message indicating the duration constraint violation.

data.message: Duration value should not be greater than 24hrs or less than 5mins

NotAllowedResponse1.summary: Not allowed when job sheets not configured in service preferences.
NotAllowedResponse1.description: Returned when Job_Sheet_Required is set to Yes but job sheets have not been enabled in the organization's service preferences. The API rejects the request with a NOT_ALLOWED error on the Job_Sheet_Required field.

data.message: Job Sheet is not configured in services preferences

DependentMismatchResponse3.summary: Dependent mismatch where Duration does not fit within the configured service timing window.
DependentMismatchResponse3.description: Shows an error returned when the service Duration does not fall within the configured available timings. The API responds with code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH, identifying Duration as the field whose value conflicts with the Status-driven timing requirement.

data.message: Duration does not satisfy the service timing

MandatoryNotFoundResponse1.summary: Mandatory not found when required Members field is missing
MandatoryNotFoundResponse1.description: Returned when the required Members field is absent from the request payload. The API rejects the request with a MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error identifying Members as the missing required field.

DependentFieldMissingResponse1.summary: DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error when Available_From is omitted despite Availability_Type being set.
DependentFieldMissingResponse1.description: Shows a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error response triggered when the Availability_Type field is provided but its required dependent field, Available_From, is omitted from the request payload.

InvalidDataResponse5.summary: Invalid data when Unavailable_From time is outside service availability.
InvalidDataResponse5.description: Returned when the Unavailable_From time does not fall within the configured service availability window. The API rejects the request with an INVALID_DATA error indicating the time value is out of range.

data.message: Unavailable From time does not fall within service availability

LimitExceededResponse1.summary: Limit exceeded when Members array exceeds 100-user maximum.
LimitExceededResponse1.description: Returned when the Members array contains more than 100 users, exceeding the per-service member limit. The API rejects the request with a LIMIT_EXCEEDED error on the Members field.

data.message: More than 100 users cannot be associated

LimitExceededResponse2.summary: Limit exceeded when organization has reached 500 active services.
LimitExceededResponse2.description: Returned when the organization has already reached the maximum of 500 active services and a new service with an active status is submitted. The API rejects the request with a LIMIT_EXCEEDED error on the Status field.

data.message: You cannot create more than 500 active services

DependentMismatchResponse7.summary: Dependent mismatch where Job_Sheet_Section__s is set but Job_Sheet_Required is No.
DependentMismatchResponse7.description: Shows an error returned when Job_Sheet_Section__s is supplied but Job_Sheet_Required is set to No. The API responds with code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH, indicating that Job_Sheet_Section__s may only carry a value when its controlling field Job_Sheet_Required is set to Yes.

data.message: Job_Sheet_Section__s can have value only when value of Job_Sheet_Required is Yes

DependentMismatchResponse8.summary: Dependent mismatch where the Available_Timings To value is not greater than the From value.
DependentMismatchResponse8.description: Shows an error returned when the To time in an Available_Timings window is not later than the corresponding From time. The API responds with code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH, identifying the To field as invalid because a valid availability window requires To to be strictly greater than From.

data.message: To value must be Greater than From value

DependentMismatchResponse9.summary: Dependent mismatch where Available_Dates includes a holiday or non-business day.
DependentMismatchResponse9.description: Shows an error returned when one or more dates provided in Available_Dates fall on a holiday or outside configured business days. The API responds with code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH, indicating that all Available_Dates values must correspond to valid, non-holiday business days.

data.message: Available Dates value in holiday or Not in BusinessDays

InvalidDataResponse6.summary: Invalid data when custom time value in Available_Timings is invalid.
InvalidDataResponse6.description: Returned when a custom time value supplied in the To field of Available_Timings is not a valid time. The API rejects the request with an INVALID_DATA error targeting the offending entry in the availability timings array.

data.message: The given custom time is invalid

InvalidDataResponse7.summary: Invalid data when member has not confirmed their account.
InvalidDataResponse7.description: Returned when a user specified in the Members array has not confirmed their account. The API rejects the request with an INVALID_DATA error and identifies the unconfirmed member's ID in the response.

InvalidDataResponse8.summary: Invalid data when member is inactive.
InvalidDataResponse8.description: Returned when a user specified in the Members array has an inactive status. The API rejects the request with an INVALID_DATA error because only active users may be associated with a service.

InvalidDataResponse9.summary: Invalid data when Owner field received wrong data type.
InvalidDataResponse9.description: Returned when the Owner field receives a value of an incorrect data type; the API expects a JSON object but received an incompatible type. The request is rejected with an INVALID_DATA error identifying the Owner field.

InvalidDataResponse10.summary: Owner field value exceeds the maximum allowed field length.
InvalidDataResponse10.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned when the Owner field value submitted to the Services endpoint exceeds the maximum allowed field length. The response identifies the Owner field as the source of the invalid data.

MandatoryNotFoundResponse2.summary: Mandatory not found when required Location field is missing.
MandatoryNotFoundResponse2.description: Returned when the required Location field is absent from the request payload. The API rejects the request with a MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error identifying Location as the missing required field.

DependentMismatchResponse10.summary: Dependent mismatch when Unavailable_From is invalid for Available status.
DependentMismatchResponse10.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when Unavailable_From is set while the service Status is Available, violating the dependency rule that requires Unavailable_From to be null or specified alone without Unavailable_Till.

data.message: When the service status is available, Unavailable From must be greater than current date

DependentMismatchResponse11.summary: Dependent mismatch error when Unavailable_Till is not a future datetime.
DependentMismatchResponse11.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the supplied Unavailable_Till value does not exceed the current server time, violating the temporal constraint imposed by the Status dependency. The API rejects the request indicating that Unavailable_Till must be set to a future datetime.

data.message: Unavailable Till must be greater than current Time.

DependentMismatchResponse12.summary: Dependent mismatch when both unavailability fields are set for Available status.
DependentMismatchResponse12.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when both Unavailable_From and Unavailable_Till are provided while Status is Available, which violates the rule requiring both fields to be null or only Unavailable_From to carry a value.

data.message: When the service status is available,  either both Unavailable From and Unavailable Till must be null, or only Unavailable From can have a value.

DependentMismatchResponse13.summary: Dependent mismatch where Unavailable_Till is not earlier than Unavailable_From.
DependentMismatchResponse13.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Unavailable_Till value is not chronologically later than Unavailable_From, violating the ordering constraint imposed by the Status dependency. The API rejects the request requiring Unavailable_Till to be set after Unavailable_From.

data.message: Unavailable Till must be lesser than Unavailable From

DependentMismatchResponse14.summary: Dependent mismatch when Not In Use status conflicts with a future Unavailable_From date.
DependentMismatchResponse14.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when a service record is submitted with a Status of Not In Use while Unavailable_From is set to a future date. The API rejects the request because a future unavailability start date is incompatible with the Not In Use status.

data.message: Services status cannot be marked as Not In Use when Unavailable From falls after the current Date

DependentMismatchResponse15.summary: Dependent mismatch when Available_From precedes the current date.
DependentMismatchResponse15.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Available_From field is set to a date that precedes the current date. The API rejects the request because the service availability start date must not fall before the current date.

data.message: Starting date of service availability falls before the current Date, so service cannot be marked as Scheduled

DependentMismatchResponse16.summary: Dependent mismatch when a past Available_Till conflicts with an active service status.
DependentMismatchResponse16.description:
Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when Available_Till is set to a past date while the service Status is Available, Scheduled, or Temporarily Unavailable. 

The API rejects the request because an expired availability end date is incompatible with those active status values.

data.message: End Date of service availability falls before the current Date, so service cannot be marked as Available or Scheduled or Temporarily Unavailable

InvalidDataResponse11.summary: Unavailable_From time falls outside the service availability window.
InvalidDataResponse11.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned when the Unavailable_From time submitted to the Services endpoint falls outside the configured availability window for the service. The response identifies the Unavailable_From field as the source of the scheduling conflict.

data.message: Unavailable From time does not fall within service availability

DependentFieldMissingResponse2.summary: Dependent field missing error when Unavailable_From is absent for Status.
DependentFieldMissingResponse2.description: Shows a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error response triggered when the Status field is provided but its required dependent field, Unavailable_From, is absent from the request payload.

InvalidDataResponse12.summary: Invalid data error returned with no specific error code in the payload.
InvalidDataResponse12.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned for a service record that contains invalid field data. This example represents a minimal error response where no specific error code is present in the payload.

value.message: invalid data

InvalidDataResponse13.summary: Status field rejected due to incorrect data type instead of expected text.
InvalidDataResponse13.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned when the Status field receives a value of an incorrect data type instead of the expected text type. The response identifies the Status field and specifies that the expected data type is text.

InvalidDataResponse14.summary: Status value exceeds maximum allowed length.
InvalidDataResponse14.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned when the Status field value exceeds the maximum allowed length of 120 characters. The response identifies the Status field as the source of the length violation.

InvalidDataResponse15.summary: Unavailable_Till contains an unsupported picklist value.
InvalidDataResponse15.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Unavailable_Till field contains a value not in the supported picklist. The accepted values are Temporarily Unavailable, Available, Not In Use, and Scheduled.

InvalidDataResponse16.summary: Job_Sheet_Required receives an invalid data type.
InvalidDataResponse16.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Job_Sheet_Required field receives a value of an incorrect data type instead of the expected text type. The API rejects the request with an invalid data type message.

InvalidDataResponse17.summary: Job_Sheet_Required value exceeds the maximum allowed length.
InvalidDataResponse17.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Job_Sheet_Required field contains a value that exceeds the maximum allowed length of three characters. The API rejects the request with an invalid data message.

DependentMismatchResponse17.summary: Dependent mismatch when a scheduled service is set to Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable.
DependentMismatchResponse17.description:
Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when a status of Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable is requested for a service that has future appointments scheduled. 

The API rejects the request because a service with upcoming bookings must retain a status compatible with active scheduling.

data.message: Service status cannot be marked as Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable for scheduled services.

delete.summary: Delete one or more service records
delete.description: To delete one or more service records from your Zoho CRM organization. All appointments associated with the deleted services are also deleted; however, deals created upon completion of those appointments are not deleted.

200.description: Returns the result of a single-record service delete operation. The response body contains a `data` array with one entry that includes the status code `SUCCESS`, the deleted record ID, a confirmation message, and the operation status.

Success200.description: Represents a successful single-record delete response from the DELETE operation. The data array contains one entry with code=SUCCESS, the deleted service ID under `details.id`, message="record deleted", and status="success".

207.description: Returns a multi-status response. Each item in the array independently indicates success or failure for the corresponding service ID in the ids query parameter.

Success207.summary: Mixed batch delete when one record deleted, one fails with INVALID_DATA
Success207.description: Represents a multi-status response from the DELETE /Services__s endpoint when a batch delete yields mixed results. The data array contains one entry with code=SUCCESS indicating a successfully deleted record and one entry with code=INVALID_DATA indicating a record that could not be deleted.

400.description:
Returned when the service ID is invalid or already deleted, the `ids` query parameter is missing, or the module name is unrecognized.

**Resolution:** A valid service record ID must be supplied in the `ids` query parameter. The module name must match a recognized API name before retrying the request.

InvalidDataResponse1.summary: Delete fails with INVALID_DATA where service ID is incorrect or already deleted
InvalidDataResponse1.description: Represents an error response from the DELETE operation when the provided service ID is incorrect or refers to an already-deleted record. The payload carries code=INVALID_DATA, the offending ID under `details.id`, message='record not deleted', and status='error'.

value.message: record not deleted

InvalidModuleResponse1.summary: Delete fails with INVALID_MODULE when module name in the request URL is invalid
InvalidModuleResponse1.description: Represents an error response from the DELETE operation when the module name in the request URL is invalid. The payload carries code=INVALID_MODULE, details.resource_path_index=0, message='the module name given seems to be invalid', and status='error'.

value.message: the module name given seems to be invalid

RequiredParamMissingResponse1.summary: Required parameter missing when ids query parameter absent from DELETE request
RequiredParamMissingResponse1.description: Error response returned when the `ids` query parameter is omitted from the DELETE /Services__s request. Including the `ids` query parameter with at least one valid service record ID resolves this error.

value.message: One of the expected parameter is missing

InternalErrorResponse1.summary: Delete request fails due to an internal server error
InternalErrorResponse1.description: Represents an error response from the DELETE operation when an internal server error occurs during processing. The payload carries code=INTERNAL_ERROR, message='internal server error', and status='error'.

value.message: Internal Server Error

get.summary: Retrieve a specific service record by ID
get.description: To retrieve the full details of a single service record from your Zoho CRM organization using its unique ID, including its availability configuration, members, pricing, tax details, and subform data.

200.description: Returns the full details of the requested service record, including its availability configuration, members, owner, pricing, tax, audit timestamps, and currency-formatted values.

Success200.summary: Successful retrieval of a service record by ID
Success200.description: Represents a successful response to the Get Service by ID request. The response contains a single service record with its complete set of fields, including availability configuration, members, owner, pricing, tax, and audit timestamps.

400.description:
The request cannot be processed because the module name in the URL is invalid or a required query parameter is missing.

**Resolution:** Ensure the module API name in the request URL references an existing module and that all required query parameters are included in the request.

InvalidModuleResponse1.summary: An error response for an invalid module name in the request URL
InvalidModuleResponse1.description: Represents a 400 error response returned when the module name in the request URL does not match any existing module. The code field is set to INVALID_MODULE and details.resource_path_index identifies the position of the invalid segment in the resource path.

value.message: the module name given seems to be invalid

RequiredParamMissingResponse1.summary: An error response for a missing required query parameter
RequiredParamMissingResponse1.description: Represents a 400 error response returned when a required query parameter is absent from the request. The code field is set to REQUIRED_PARAM_MISSING and details.param_name identifies the missing parameter, in this example fields.

value.message: One of the expected parameter is missing

put.summary: Update a specific service record by ID
put.description: To update a single service record in your Zoho CRM organization, identified by its unique ID. Only the fields supplied in the request payload are modified on the targeted service.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain a data array with one object representing the service record to update.

SamplePutRequest.summary: Service update with availability, status, and pricing fields.
SamplePutRequest.description: Demonstrates a PUT request to update a service record with a 30-minute duration, Business Address location, Specific Day(s) availability across Monday through Wednesday, one assigned member, Not in Use status, configured available date range, a defined price, and Job Sheet Required set to No.

200.description: Returns a success status with the updated service record's ID, audit metadata (creation and modification timestamps and users), and the affected_data block reflecting the applied changes.

Success200.description: Represents a successful service record update, returning a SUCCESS code along with modification metadata, the record ID, and affected data indicating whether a process flow was triggered.

400.description:
The request could not be processed because the service record contains invalid field values, is missing a required dependent field, violates a service-availability constraint, or has exceeded the active service limit.

**Resolution:** The error response identifies the offending field and error code; correct the corresponding values in the request payload and resubmit the request.

InvalidDataResponse1.summary: INVALID_DATA on Availability_Type value not found in picklist.
InvalidDataResponse1.description: Returned when the supplied Availability_Type value does not match any entry in the configured picklist. The INVALID_DATA error indicates that only predefined picklist values are accepted for the Availability_Type field.

data.message: The given Availability Type is not in picklist

DependentMismatchResponse1.summary: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH when Available_Days not within configured business days.
DependentMismatchResponse1.description: Returned when the provided Available_Days values fall outside the configured business days. The response identifies the conflicting Available_Days field and the dependee Status field responsible for the validation constraint.

data.message: The given Available Days are not there in business days

DependentMismatchResponse2.summary: To field violates business timing for the given Status.
DependentMismatchResponse2.description: Returned when the To field specifies a service availability time that falls outside the permitted business hours based on the current Status. This scenario demonstrates that the service available time window must align with defined business timing constraints.

data.message: Service available time does not satisfy the business timing

InvalidDataResponse2.summary: INVALID_DATA error for Available_Dates due to date format mismatch.
InvalidDataResponse2.description: The server returns INVALID_DATA when the Available_Dates field contains a value in an unrecognised date format. The api_name field in the response identifies Available_Dates as the source of the error.

DependentMismatchResponse3.summary: Duration does not satisfy service timing for the given Status.
DependentMismatchResponse3.description: Returned when the Duration field does not conform to the timing constraints defined by the current service Status. This scenario demonstrates that the service duration must fall within the bounds permitted by the associated service timing rules.

data.message: Duration does not satisfy the service timing

DependentFieldMissingResponse1.summary: DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING when Unavailable_From required when Status is Temporarily Unavailable.
DependentFieldMissingResponse1.description: Returned when the Unavailable_From field is omitted while Status is set to Temporarily Unavailable. The response identifies the missing dependent field and the Status field that triggered the requirement.

LimitExceededResponse1.summary: LIMIT_EXCEEDED error for Members exceeding the 100-user association cap.
LimitExceededResponse1.description: The server returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED when the Members field exceeds the maximum allowed association of 100 users. The api_name field in the response identifies Members as the source of the limit violation.

data.message: More than 100 users cannot be associated

LimitExceededResponse2.summary: LIMIT_EXCEEDED error for Status breaching the 500 active services limit.
LimitExceededResponse2.description: The server returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED when updating the Status field would cause the organisation to exceed the 500 active service limit. The api_name field in the response identifies Status as the source of the limit violation.

data.message: You cannot create more than 500 active services

DependentMismatchResponse7.summary: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH on Job_Sheet_Section__s requiring Job_Sheet_Required as Yes.
DependentMismatchResponse7.description: Returned when Job_Sheet_Section__s is provided without Job_Sheet_Required being set to Yes. The DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error indicates that Job_Sheet_Section__s can only hold a value when its dependency Job_Sheet_Required equals Yes.

data.message: Job_Sheet_Section__s can have value only when value of Job_Sheet_Required is Yes

DependentMismatchResponse8.summary: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH on Available_Till where To value must exceed Available_From.
DependentMismatchResponse8.description: Returned when the Available_Till value is not greater than the Available_From value. The DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error enforces that the To value of Available_Till must exceed the From value of Available_From.

data.message: To value must be Greater than From value

DependentMismatchResponse9.summary: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH on Available_Dates falling on a holiday or non-business day.
DependentMismatchResponse9.description: Returned when Available_Dates contains a date that falls on a holiday or outside defined business days relative to the Status field. The DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error indicates the supplied Available_Dates value conflicts with the Status-dependent business day constraints.

data.message: Available Dates value in holiday or Not in BusinessDays

InvalidDataResponse3.summary: INVALID_DATA error for Members record because member is not Confirmed.
InvalidDataResponse3.description: The server returns INVALID_DATA when the Members record referenced by ID is not in a Confirmed state. The api_name field in the response identifies the Members record as the source of the validation failure.

InvalidDataResponse4.summary: INVALID_DATA error for Members record because member is not Active.
InvalidDataResponse4.description: The server returns INVALID_DATA when the Members record referenced by ID is not in an Active state. The api_name field in the response identifies the Members record as the source of the validation failure.

InvalidDataResponse5.summary: INVALID_DATA error for Job_Sheet_Required due to incorrect data type.
InvalidDataResponse5.description: The server returns INVALID_DATA when the Job_Sheet_Required field receives a value of an incorrect data type. The api_name field in the response identifies Job_Sheet_Required as the source of the type mismatch.

InvalidDataResponse6.summary: INVALID_DATA error for Job_Sheet_Required due to an invalid value.
InvalidDataResponse6.description: The server returns INVALID_DATA when the Job_Sheet_Required field contains a value that is not permitted. The api_name field in the response identifies Job_Sheet_Required as the source of the invalid value.

DependentMismatchResponse10.summary: Status available but Unavailable_From is not a future date.
DependentMismatchResponse10.description: Returned when the Status field is set to available but Unavailable_From does not fall after the current date. This scenario demonstrates that Unavailable_From must be a future date whenever the service status is available.

data.message: When the service status is available, Unavailable From must be greater than current date

DependentMismatchResponse11.summary: Unavailable_Till is not greater than the current time
DependentMismatchResponse11.description: Returned when Unavailable_Till is set to a value that does not exceed the current time as required by the dependent Status field. This scenario demonstrates that Unavailable_Till must always be a future timestamp relative to the current time.

data.message: Unavailable Till must be greater than current Time.

DependentMismatchResponse12.summary: Status available with invalid Unavailable_Till null/value combination.
DependentMismatchResponse12.description: Returned when Status is available but Unavailable_Till is provided in a configuration that violates the allowed null/value combination. This scenario demonstrates that when status is available, Unavailable_Till must be null unless Unavailable_From also carries a value.

data.message: When the service status is available,  either both Unavailable From and Unavailable Till must be null, or only Unavailable From can have a value.

DependentMismatchResponse13.summary: Unavailable_Till is not lesser than Unavailable_From.
DependentMismatchResponse13.description: Returned when Unavailable_Till is set to a value that is not less than Unavailable_From, violating the required chronological ordering. This scenario demonstrates that Unavailable_Till must always precede Unavailable_From in time.

data.message: Unavailable Till must be lesser than Unavailable From

DependentMismatchResponse14.summary: Unavailable_Till set on a scheduled service with Available_From.
DependentMismatchResponse14.description: Returned when Unavailable_Till is supplied for a service that has a scheduled Available_From date, making Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable statuses invalid. This scenario demonstrates that scheduled services cannot be transitioned to Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable states.

data.message: Service status cannot be marked as Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable for scheduled services.

DependentMismatchResponse15.summary: Status Not In Use conflicts with a future Unavailable_From date.
DependentMismatchResponse15.description: Returned when Status is set to Not In Use but Unavailable_From is a future date, making the transition invalid. This scenario demonstrates that a Not In Use status cannot be applied when Unavailable_From extends beyond the current date.

data.message: Services status cannot be marked as Not In Use when Unavailable From falls after the current Date

DependentMismatchResponse16.summary: Status Scheduled but Available_From is a past date
DependentMismatchResponse16.description: Returned when Status is set to Scheduled but Available_From falls before the current date, making the scheduling invalid. This scenario demonstrates that a Scheduled status requires Available_From to be a future date.

data.message: Starting date of service availability falls before the current Date, so service cannot be marked as Scheduled

DependentMismatchResponse17.summary: Status conflicts with an expired Available_Till date
DependentMismatchResponse17.description: Returned when Status is set to Available, Scheduled, or Temporarily Unavailable but Available_Till has already passed the current date. This scenario demonstrates that an expired Available_Till prevents the service from being placed in any active or forward-looking status.

data.message: End Date of service availability falls before the current Date, so service cannot be marked as Available or Scheduled or Temporarily Unavailable

InvalidDataResponse7.summary: INVALID_DATA error for Unavailable_From outside service availability window.
InvalidDataResponse7.description: The server returns INVALID_DATA when the Unavailable_From time falls outside the configured service availability window. The api_name field in the response identifies Unavailable_From as the source of the scheduling conflict.

data.message: Unavailable From time does not fall within service availability

DependentFieldMissingResponse2.summary: DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING when Available_Days required when Availability_Type is Specific Day(s).
DependentFieldMissingResponse2.description: Returned when Available_Days is omitted while Availability_Type is set to Specific Day(s). The response identifies the missing dependent field and the Availability_Type field that triggered the requirement.

InvalidDataResponse8.summary: INVALID_DATA error for the data field with a null or unprocessable value.
InvalidDataResponse8.description: The server returns INVALID_DATA when the data field contains a null or otherwise invalid payload that cannot be processed. The api_name field in the response identifies data as the source of the error.

value.message: invalid data

InvalidDataResponse9.summary: INVALID_DATA error for Status field due to incorrect data type.
InvalidDataResponse9.description: The server returns INVALID_DATA when the Status field receives a value of an incorrect data type. The api_name field in the response identifies Status as the source of the type mismatch.

InvalidDataResponse10.summary: INVALID_DATA on Status field containing an unacceptable value.
InvalidDataResponse10.description: Returned when the value provided for the Status field fails server-side data validation. The INVALID_DATA error indicates the Status value is malformed or does not conform to the expected format or allowed values.

InvalidDataResponse11.summary: INVALID_DATA on Unavailable_Till field containing a malformed value.
InvalidDataResponse11.description: Returned when the value submitted for Unavailable_Till fails server-side data validation. The INVALID_DATA error indicates the Unavailable_Till value is malformed or does not conform to the expected date-time format.

InvalidDataResponse12.summary: INVALID_DATA on Duration outside the permitted range.
InvalidDataResponse12.description: Returned when the Duration value exceeds 24 hours or is less than five minutes. The INVALID_DATA error indicates the submitted Duration is outside the permitted range.

data.message: Duration value should not be greater than 24hrs or less than 5mins

NotAllowedResponse1.summary: NOT_ALLOWED error for Job_Sheet_Required when Job Sheet is unconfigured.
NotAllowedResponse1.description: The server returns NOT_ALLOWED when the Job_Sheet_Required field is supplied but Job Sheet has not been configured in services preferences. The api_name field in the response identifies Job_Sheet_Required as the source of the restriction.

post.description:
To share a specific record in a module with one or more users, roles, or groups. A record can be shared with up to 10 users, 5 roles, and 5 groups.
> **Note**:
> - The records can be shared to other users in the organization only if certain conditions are met. For simplicity, let us assume that User A shares a record with User B. Now, User A can share the record successfully only if:
>    - User B is a **confirmed** and **active** user.
>    - User B **does not already have access** to that particular record.
>    - User B has access to that particular module. For instance, to share a contact, User B must have access to the Contacts module.
> - You cannot share the records in Calls, Meetings, Tasks, and Linking modules directly. They can be shared as related lists.
> - The users who have profiles with **share** permission can share any records that they have access to, except the records that are shared to them. To check the same, go to Setup > Users and Control > Security Control > Choose the profile > Tool Permissions. Check if **share** is enabled. It is enabled by default for Standard and Administrator Profiles.
> - The details of the records that form many-to-many relationships (with multi-select lookup) cannot be shared.
> - A record can be shared only with **10 users**, **5 groups**, and **5 roles**.
> - Once the record gets shared successfully, the user who initiated the share operation can be notified via email.

get.description: To retrieve the wizard configurations available in your Zoho CRM organization. The response can be filtered by module using the `**module**` query parameter. When you set up conditional rules for a wizard, the response contains the keys execute_on and type. execute_on represents when the conditional rule is executed. The values are create, edit, and create_edit. type represents the action you want to take when the condition is met. The values are set_values, set_lock, show_component, and show_widget. When type=set_lock, the response contains the key exempted_profiles. This array contains the list of profiles that allow edits even after locking specific fields. The color_palette key is added that displays the colors available for a button on a screen. Note that this key is available in the response only if you have chosen at least one custom color for the button on a screen. Changes made to this API from version 5 when you fetch a specific wizard in a layout: - A new JSON array portal_user_types is added to the response that displays the list of portal user types that have access to the wizard. - A new JSON array exempted_portal_user_types is added to the response that represents the list of portal user types that have access to wizards that are blocked for other user types. - Under the segments, for buttons, the Profiles JSON array is added. This indicates the profiles that have access to that button in that screen. - In the Screens JSON array, the "type" of segments JSON object is changed from fields to composite. - In the segments JSON array, the fields JSON array is renamed to elements. - Each object in the elements JSON array contains the sequence number, resource, and type keys. Resource includes the "name" and "id" of the field or the query component on the screen. type indicates whether the resource is a field or query component. From V6, you can get the list of available screens in Wizards. See the sample response for reference.

put.description: PURPOSE: Updates an existing automation task definition identified by the path parameter ID. PREREQUISITES: (1) Call GET /settings/automation/tasks/{id} to obtain the current task structure. (2) Call GET /settings/layouts?module=Tasks to verify supported fields and identify mandatory fields where required: true in the field info. BEHAVIOR: This is a full replacement - all field_mappings must be provided, not just the changed ones. KEY CONSTRAINTS: Locked tasks (locked by workflow rules, approval processes, or blueprints) return 401 AUTHORIZATION_ERROR. Read-only tasks return 400.

400.description: Validation error in request payload. Two response shapes exist: (1) Request-structure errors (e.g., invalid task ID, read-only task, invalid module type/length, missing field api_name) return tasks as a single error object. (2) Per-task validation errors (e.g., field_mapping errors, dependent mismatch, mandatory not found) return tasks as an array with one error object per task entry. Parse tasks as either object or array to handle both shapes.

EqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

EqualityFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

TextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

OrderingFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

BetweenFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

SetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

MultiSelectLookupFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

SimpleFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

AutomationModuleRef.title: Automation Module Reference

api_name.description: API name of the module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Vendors).

id.description: Unique module ID (19-digit format). Always use the full ID as returned by GET /settings/modules - truncated or shortened IDs return INVALID_DATA ('the tabId given seems to be invalid'). Optional in requests if api_name is provided; always present in responses.

AutomationModuleRef.description: PURPOSE: Module reference used across non-associate actions. At least one of api_name or id required (EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither). If both given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). GET /settings/modules to discover. Always use full 19-digit module ID.
AutomationModuleRef.x-zs-llm-description: Module reference for action targeting. At least one of api_name or id required  EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither is present. If both provided and they refer to different modules  AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getModules. Used in most non-associate action details to specify where the action operates.

AutomationLayoutRef.title: Automation Layout Reference

name.description: Display name of the layout. Optional in requests; present in GET responses.

display_label.description: Human-readable label of the layout. Present in GET responses.

AutomationLayoutRef.description: PURPOSE: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call actions. MANDATORY: id (string). Determines field availability and validation rules. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} to discover.
