AutomationFieldAttributes.title: Automation Field Attributes

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the target field in the destination module — for example, Subject, Due_Date, or Owner — used to identify the field receiving the mapped value within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, and convert.

id.description: Represents the numeric identifier of the target CRM field. Used in conjunction with the field's API name, both of which must resolve to the same field for a mapping to be valid.

AutomationFieldAttributes.description: Identifies the target CRM field to which a mapping value is applied within an automation rule. The api_name and ID properties must both be supplied and must refer to the same field; a mismatch between the two causes an AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING error. Available fields for a given module can be discovered via GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.
AutomationFieldAttributes.x-zs-llm-description: Target field identifier. Both api_name and id are mandatory  providing only one still works but both should be given for reliability. If both provided and they refer to different fields: AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getFields?module={module_api_name}. The field must be writable and compatible with mapping type.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type expected for the dependent field given the parent field's current value.

DependentMismatchDetailsOneOf2.description: Represents the variant of DependentMismatchDetails in which the expected data type for the dependent field is conveyed through expected_data_type.

items.description: A single picklist option string to include in the multi-select field value. Each entry corresponds to one selectable option as defined for the target field in Zoho CRM.

StaticArrayValue.description: Represents an array of string values used as the static value for multiselectpicklist fields, where each element corresponds to an available picklist option. Valid option labels are retrievable from the GET /settings/fields endpoint filtered by data_type=multiselectpicklist.
StaticArrayValue.x-zs-llm-description: Array value for type=static on multiselect_picklist fields. Each element must match an available picklist option. Discover valid options from getFields for the target module. Invalid options return INVALID_DATA.

StaticObjectValue.title: Static Object Value

id.description: The system identifier of the referenced entity, such as a user or layout record. This value drives entity resolution by the automation engine and must be provided when the target field references an entity.

name.description: The display name of the referenced entity, such as a user full name or a layout label. When omitted from a request payload, the server resolves and populates this property from the supplied ID. The property is present in all GET responses.

StaticObjectValue.description: Represents an object value used as the static value for ownerlookup and layout fields, containing an ID that identifies the target user or layout and an optional name that the server resolves from the ID when not supplied. Typically used to assign record ownership by providing the user ID.
StaticObjectValue.x-zs-llm-description: Object value for type=static on ownerlookup and layout fields. id is mandatory (user ID or layout ID). name is optional server resolves from id. Use getUsers for owner IDs, getLayouts for layout IDs.

StaticFieldMapping.title: Static Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

StaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.
StaticFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='static' mapping. Value is used as-is without runtime resolution. NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields (use execution_time  static returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). NOT for unique fields or formula fields. Value structure depends on field data_type: string for most fields, array for multiselect_picklist, object for ownerlookup/layout.

items.description: Represents an allowed value for the dependent field.

supported_values.description: Represents the list of allowed values for the dependent field given the parent field's current value.

DependentMismatchDetailsOneOf1.description: Represents the variant of DependentMismatchDetails in which the allowed values for the dependent field are conveyed through the supported_values list.

MergeFieldMapping.title: Merge Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

value.description: Represents the string value carried by a merge_field mapping, containing one or more runtime-resolved token references. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), lookup traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Tokens may be combined with surrounding text for multi-line field targets. Fields that hold a single typed value such as email or URL accept exactly one token.

allow_agent_user.description:
Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values:
**true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users.
**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

MergeFieldMapping.description: Represents a merge_field-type mapping whose value is resolved at execution time by substituting token references with live field data. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Applies to text-based fields such as Subject, Description, and custom text fields. Targeting owner or lookup fields with this type produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error; those fields require a static mapping using an object with a numeric identifier and an optional name. Multiple tokens may be chained with surrounding text for multi-line fields, while single-value fields such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
MergeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='merge_field' mapping. Value contains ${!Module.Field} tokens resolved at execution time. ONLY for text-based fields (Subject, Description, etc.)  using on date/number/picklist fields returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Supports lookup traversal: ${!Module.Lookup.Field}. Multi-module not supported.

ExecutionTimeValue.title: Execution Time Value

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

ExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.
ExecutionTimeValue.x-zs-llm-description: Offset computation object for date/datetime/ALARM fields. Required fields: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (string integer  quantity), trigger_field (merge-field token like ${!Leads.Created_Time} or ${CURRENTTIME}). Optional: sign ('positive' for after, 'negative' for before  default varies by context). Missing required fields return DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING.

ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.title: Execution Time Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.
ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='execution_time' mapping. REQUIRED for Date, DateTime, and ALARM field types (static/merge_field on these returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Computes value as offset from trigger_field. Value object needs: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (integer as string), trigger_field (merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}), sign (for before/after offset).

CompositeFieldMapping.title: Composite Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

CompositeFieldMapping.description: Represents a composite-type field mapping used exclusively for the Participants field in the Events module via the add_meeting action. The value carries a structured object that encodes participant data and is not applicable to any other field or automation action type.
CompositeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='composite' mapping. Used ONLY for the Participants field in Events module (add_meeting action). Value is a structured object representing multiple participant entries. Cannot be used on other field types  returns NOT_ALLOWED.

AutomationFieldMappings.title: Automation Field Mappings

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

allow_agent_user.description:
Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values:
**true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users.
**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

AutomationFieldMappings.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping used within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. Each mapping identifies a target field via api_name or ID, declares a type discriminator that determines value interpretation, and supplies a value whose shape varies by type: static supplies a literal value, merge_field supplies a runtime-resolved token string, execution_time supplies a date or datetime offset object, and composite supplies structured participant data for the Events Participants field. The field_mappings array must include all fields the target module requires; omitting any produces a REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND error.
AutomationFieldMappings.x-zs-llm-description: A single field-to-value mapping entry used in create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, and workflow task actions. Each entry targets one field and assigns a typed value. The type field discriminates the value structure: static (literal), merge_field (runtime token), execution_time (date offset), composite (multi-value). field identifies the target, type selects the value schema, value provides the data.

AutomationScheduleCallDetails.title: Automation Schedule Call Details

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Call. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Subject"}, "type": "static", "value": "Follow-up"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. Call_Type is system-mandatory (values: "Outbound", "Inbound", "Missed") - omitting returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Common fields: Subject, Call_Type, Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Phone} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Call_Start_Time and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Call record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this schedule call action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationScheduleCallDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for schedule_call action. Creates a Call record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Calls for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Calls', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Subject, Call_Type). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). KEY FIELDS: Subject, Call_Type ('Outbound'|'Inbound'|'Missed'), Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At.
AutomationScheduleCallDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='schedule_call'. Creates a Calls record. Requires module (Calls), layout, field_mappings (must include Subject). Key fields: Subject, Call_Purpose, Call_Type, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Same field_mapping structure as create_record. Optional: apply_restriction.

The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values returned for the set comparison.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the set filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

SetFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the in and not_in comparators. The value is an array of primitive values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references returned for the multi-select comparison.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the multi-select lookup filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

MultiSelectLookupFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the equal filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

SimpleFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a simple field-based filter criterion, dispatching to the appropriate comparator-specific response schema.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the grouped filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable condition within the group.

GroupedFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the grouped filter criterion returned in the response, containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the equal filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

FilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion returned in the response, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the child relationship module used to identify the relationship.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the child relationship module record.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the related module relationship referenced by this criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an unresolvable or deleted relationship definition.

ChildRelationshipReference.description: Represents the reference to a child relationship module. The api_name property is required to identify the child relationship.

CrossFiltersResponse.description: Represents the list of cross-filter objects returned in the response, applied to the Custom View.

message.description: Represents a descriptive message explaining the data type error encountered for the filter parameter.

FilterInvalidParamDataType.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter parameter is supplied with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, and details identifying the offending parameter along with its expected data type.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the nature of the error returned by the API.

FilterNotSupportedApiName.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter criterion references a field API name that is not supported for filtering. The details object identifies the unsupported field and its location within the filter parameter.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the missing comparator value error.

FilterFieldComparatorValueMissing.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field that requires a comparator value is submitted without one, typically because a required upstream dependee field is absent from the filter expression.

message.description: Represents a short, descriptive summary of the comparator-field dependency violation.

FilterFieldComparatorMismatch.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field's comparator value does not match any of the values permitted by the upstream dependee field's value. Contains the offending field's API name and JSONPath location, the dependee field's identity, the filter parameter context, and the list of supported comparator values.

message.description: Contains a descriptive explanation of the filter field value mismatch error.

FilterFieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter field's value carries a data type that does not satisfy the requirement imposed by its dependee field's current value.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message summarizing the comparator-value mismatch encountered in the filter request.

FilterComparatorValueMismatch.description: Represents an error returned when a value associated with a filter comparator fails validation due to constraints imposed by a dependee field. This error targets the value driven by the comparator rather than the comparator operator selection itself.

message.description: Contains a descriptive summary of the invalid-comparator error, identifying the rejected operator and the affected filter parameter.

FilterInvalidComparator.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field is provided with a comparator operator that is not supported for that field. The error code is INVALID_DATA.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the empty filter object error.

FilterEmptyFilterObject.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter object is submitted without any recognized fields — such as group or criteria — where at least one is required for the expression to be valid. The error code is EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.

message.description: Contains a brief error message describing which mandatory field was not found in the filter criteria.

FilterMandatoryNotFound.description: Represents an error response returned when a mandatory field required by the filter criteria is absent from the request. Includes a filter-specific param_name field that extends the standard MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error structure.

CrossFiltersRequest.description: Represents a list of cross-filter objects that filter Custom View records based on related module records' criteria.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the invalid data type failure in a form suitable for display or logging.

InvalidDataType.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion field value is provided with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, the response status, and details identifying the offending field and its expected data type.

message.description: Error message describing the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING condition returned in the response envelope.

FieldComparatorValueMissing.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion comparator cannot be applied because the comparator value supplied by the dependee field is absent. Carries error code DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING along with details identifying both the field in error and the dependee field whose value is missing.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the comparator mismatch condition for the criterion field.

FieldComparatorMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value supplied for a criterion field does not match the valid comparator values determined by its dependee field. Contains the error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and a details object identifying the criterion field, its dependee field, and the list of supported comparator values.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the field value mismatch error.

FieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when the data type of the value supplied for a criterion field does not match the expected data type determined by the dependee field. Returned with error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Contains details identifying the mismatched criterion field, its dependee field, and the expected data type.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the comparator value mismatch error.

ComparatorValueMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value itself does not satisfy the dependency validation rules imposed by the dependee field. Carries error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and includes details identifying the criterion field with the invalid comparator value, its dependee field (api_name, json_path), and the criterion field own api_name and json_path.

message.description: Descriptive error message conveying the nature of the invalid comparator condition to the caller.

InvalidComparator.description: Error schema returned when the comparator specified in a criterion field is not one of the allowed comparator values for the given field type. Returned with error code INVALID_DATA. The details object identifies the offending field by API name and JSON path, and enumerates the supported comparator values.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message explaining why the lookup field limit was exceeded.

LookupLimitExceeded.description: Represents the error response returned when the count of lookup fields used in criterion expressions exceeds the allowed limit. The error code is LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The details object contains a used_in array (minItems: 1, maxItems: 10) in which each entry identifies an affected location by name and provides the relevant lookup fields and the applicable lookup limit.

created_time.description: Date-time when this field update action was created.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) should be enforced when updating the field. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before applying the update. Ignored for non-Owner fields.

editable.description: Whether the current user can edit this field update action.

deletable.description: Represents whether the current user can delete this field update action.

source.description: Source application that created or manages this action (e.g., crm).

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new record owner when the Owner field is updated via this action. Only applicable when the target field is an Owner field. When true, the newly assigned owner receives an email informing them of the ownership change. Ignored for non-Owner fields.

modified_time.description: Date-time when this field update action was last modified.

dependent_fields.description: Dependent fields that must be set alongside the target field when dependency rules apply. Includes patterns such as Pipeline -> Stage and Layout -> Pipeline -> Stage (nested). Nested dependencies can be represented through dependent_fields within each item. Null when the target field has no dependency rules configured.

associated.description: Whether this action is currently linked to any automation rule, approval process, or blueprint.

related_records.description: List of related modules whose record ownership should also be transferred along with the parent record when the Owner field is updated. Only applicable when the target field is an Owner field. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional related modules are available depending on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Null when the target field is not an Owner field or when no related modules are selected for ownership transfer.

FieldUpdateConfigurationForCreate.title: Field Update Configuration For Create

name.description: Name of the field update action. Must be unique within the org. This label is displayed in the automation rule configuration UI.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new owner when the Owner field is updated. Required when the target field is Owner (omitting returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING). Must not be sent when the target field is not Owner (returns NOT_ALLOWED).

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules when updating the Owner field. This key is applicable only for Owner updates, and is required only when active owner-assignment thresholds exist for the module. If thresholds are not configured, sending this key can be rejected as not allowed.

dependent_fields.description: Dependent fields that must be set alongside the target field. Required for dependent picklist relationships. Common chains: Pipeline -> Stage, Layout -> Pipeline, and Layout -> Pipeline -> Stage (nested via dependent_fields inside the Pipeline node).

related_records.description: Related modules whose open record ownership should also be transferred when the Owner field is updated. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional modules depend on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Required when the target field is Owner (omitting returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING). Must not be sent when the target field is not Owner (returns NOT_ALLOWED). Pass null to skip ownership transfer on related records.

FieldUpdateConfigurationForCreate.description: Defines a single field update action, including the target module, target field, mapping type, and the value to apply. Some properties are conditionally required depending on the target field's type — for example, Owner fields require notify and related_records.
FieldUpdateConfigurationForCreate.x-zs-llm-description: Describes a single field update action. Required: name, module ({api_name}), field ({id, api_name}), type ('static'), and a value whose shape matches the field's data_type. Conditional: Pipeline field needs a string value (pipeline name) and Stage in dependent_fields; Layout field needs an object value and Pipeline in dependent_fields; Owner field needs value={id}, notify (boolean, required), and related_records (array, required  pass null to skip). Optional: update_type ('overwrite' or 'append' for multi-select fields), apply_assignment_threshold (Owner only).

GlobalPicklistsNotSupportedFieldError.title: Global Picklists Not Supported Field Error

The param_name detail identifies the query parameter that caused the error. Includes code NOT_SUPPORTED, message 'The value given is not supported', status 'error', and details identifying the unsupported field. The json_path varies based on the parameter and its filter nesting depth (e.g. $.filters.field.api_name, $.filters.group[n].field.api_name, $.inner_details_filters[0].filters.field.api_name, $.inner_details_filters[0].filters.group[n].field.api_name, $.inner_details_filters[0].filters.group[n].group[m].field.api_name, etc.).

LayoutsUserReference.description: Represents a reference to the CRM user who performed an action, such as creating or modifying a layout, identified by their unique ID and display name.

add_field.description: Indicates whether new fields may be introduced into the layout section. Possible values: `true` — adding fields to the section is permitted; `false` — adding fields to the section is not permitted.

rename.description: Indicates whether the display name of the layout section may be changed. Possible values: `true` — renaming the section is permitted; `false` — renaming the section is not permitted.

change_tab_traversal.description: Indicates whether the keyboard tab traversal order of fields within the layout section may be modified. Possible values: `true` — changing the tab traversal order is permitted; `false` — changing the tab traversal order is not permitted.

reorder.description: Indicates whether the relative ordering of sections or fields within the layout may be changed. Possible values: `true` — reordering is permitted; `false` — reordering is not permitted.

delete.description: Indicates whether the layout section may be permanently removed from the layout. Possible values: `true` — deleting the section is permitted; `false` — deleting the section is not permitted.

remove_field.description: Indicates whether existing fields may be detached from the layout section. Possible values: `true` — removing fields from the section is permitted; `false` — removing fields from the section is not permitted.

change_column_count.description: Indicates whether the number of columns displayed within the layout section may be modified. Possible values: `true` — adjusting the column count for the section is permitted; `false` — adjusting the column count for the section is not permitted.

ActionsAllowed.description: Represents the set of Boolean permission flags indicating which modification operations are permitted on a layout section, such as adding fields, renaming, reordering, and deleting.

edit.description: Indicates whether the layout's field arrangement, sections, and configuration can be modified. Possible values: `true` — editing the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout is locked against edits.

rename.description: Indicates whether the layout's display name can be changed. Possible values: `true` — renaming the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout name is locked.

clone.description: Indicates whether the layout can be duplicated to create a new layout with the same field and section configuration. Possible values: `true` — cloning the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout cannot be cloned.

downgrade.description: Indicates whether the layout can be downgraded to a lower-tier configuration or reverted to a previous edition-level feature set. Possible values: `true` — downgrading the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout cannot be downgraded.

delete.description: Indicates whether the layout can be permanently removed from the module configuration. Possible values: `true` — deleting the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout cannot be deleted.

deactivate.description: Indicates whether the layout can be deactivated, preventing it from being assigned to new records while preserving existing associations. Possible values: `true` — deactivating the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout cannot be deactivated.

set_layout_permissions.description: Indicates whether profile-level permission assignments for the layout can be configured. Possible values: `true` — managing layout permissions is permitted; `false` — permission settings cannot be modified for this layout.

LayoutActionsAllowed.description: Represents the set of Boolean permission flags indicating which operations are permitted on a layout, such as editing, renaming, cloning, deactivating, and deleting.

default.description: Indicates whether this profile is the default profile assignment for the layout. Possible values: `true` — this is the default profile; `false` — this is not the default profile.

name.description: Represents the display name of the CRM profile associated with this layout assignment.

id.description: Represents a unique numeric identifier for a CRM entity, expressed as a 64-bit integer serialized as a string to preserve precision in JSON.

reorder_rows.description: Indicates whether users are permitted to reorder existing rows within the subform section by dragging them to a new position. Possible values: `true` — row reordering is allowed; `false` — rows cannot be reordered.

maximum_rows.description: Indicates the maximum number of rows that can be added to the subform section, controlling how many related records can be embedded in a single parent record's layout.

preference.description: Contains the conditional display criteria for the section, defining the field conditions that must be satisfied for the section to be shown or for certain section behaviors to be applied.

SectionProperties.description: Represents the additional configuration properties for subform sections, including row-level interaction settings, tooltip configuration, and conditional display preferences.

webhook.description: Indicates whether webhook notifications are triggered when this field's value changes on a record. Possible values: `true` — changes to this field trigger configured webhook endpoints; `false` — field changes do not initiate webhook notifications.

colour_code_enabled_by_system.description: Indicates whether color-code functionality has been activated for this field by the system platform rather than by a user or administrator. Possible values: `true` — the system has enabled color coding for this field; `false` — color coding on this field is not system-activated.

field_label.description: Represents the label assigned to the field, displayed in forms, detail views, and list columns within the module layout.

field_read_only.description: Indicates whether the field is locked against user edits at the field level, independent of profile-based permissions. Possible values: `true` — the field value cannot be modified by users; `false` — the field is editable subject to applicable profile permissions.

required.description: Indicates whether this field must contain a value before a record can be saved. Possible values: `true` — the field is mandatory and a value must be supplied; `false` — the field is optional.

display_label.description: Represents the name of the field displayed in the module layout, used as the visible title in forms, list views, and detail pages.

read_only.description: Indicates whether this field is locked against user edits through the CRM interface and API, preventing any modification of its value after it has been set. Possible values: `true` — the field cannot be modified; `false` — the field is editable subject to applicable permissions.

businesscard_supported.description: Indicates whether the field is eligible to appear on the business card view, which surfaces key record details in compact preview panels across Zoho CRM. Possible values: `true` — the field can be included in the business card layout; `false` — the field is excluded from business card display.

id.description: Represents a unique numeric identifier for a CRM entity, expressed as a 64-bit integer serialized as a string to preserve precision in JSON.

filterable.description: Indicates whether the field can be used as a filter criterion in record search, list view filtering, and report conditions. Possible values: `true` — the field is available as a filter option; `false` — the field cannot be used for filtering.

visible.description: Indicates whether this field is currently displayed in the module layout. Possible values: `true` — the field is shown in the layout and visible to users with appropriate permissions; `false` — the field is hidden from the layout.

portal_user_types.description: Contains the list of portal user type permission configurations for this field, specifying which portal user type categories can view or edit the field's value when accessing records through a customer or partner portal.

profiles.description: Contains the list of profile-level permission entries for this field, each describing the access level a specific CRM profile has to view or edit the field's value.

separator.description: Indicates whether this field functions as a visual separator element in the layout rather than a data-entry field. Possible values: `true` — the element is a layout separator that creates a visual break between sections or field groups; `false` — the element is a standard data field.

searchable.description: Indicates whether this field's value can be used as a search term in the CRM's global and module-level search functionality. Possible values: `true` — the field is indexed for search and returns results when matched; `false` — the field is excluded from search indexing.

history_tracking_enabled.description: Indicates whether change history recording is active for this field, controlling whether updates to the field's value are logged in the audit trail. Possible values: `true` — field value changes are captured and retained in history tracking; `false` — changes to this field are not recorded in the audit trail.

show_type.description: Represents the internal numeric code that controls the display behavior or rendering mode of the field in the CRM UI, supplementing the data_type classification with additional display context.

api_name.description: Represents an API identifier string composed of alphanumeric characters and underscores, used as a programmatic reference for fields, modules, and other CRM entities.

enable_colour_code.description: Indicates whether color coding is currently active for this field, allowing field values to be visually differentiated by color in list views and kanban boards. Possible values: `true` — color coding is enabled for the field; `false` — color coding is not active.

system_mandatory.description: Indicates whether this field is enforced as mandatory by the CRM system itself, as opposed to being made required through an administrator's layout configuration. Possible values: `true` — the field is system-level mandatory and cannot be made optional; `false` — the mandatory status is controlled by layout configuration.

virtual_field.description: Indicates whether this field is a computed or transient field that exists only at the API layer and does not map to a persistent database column. Possible values: `true` — the field is virtual and its value is derived at runtime; `false` — the field is backed by a database column.

display_type.description: Indicates the internal numeric code that controls how the field is rendered in the CRM UI, mapping to predefined display modes such as text box, drop-down, or date picker.

ui_type.description: Represents the internal numeric code that identifies the UI component type used to render and interact with this field in the CRM interface, such as a text input, date picker, or reference selector.

public.description: Indicates whether this field's value is accessible to external users or public-facing integrations. Possible values: `true` — the field is marked as public and may be exposed through portals or external APIs; `false` — the field is restricted to internal CRM users.

section_id.description: Indicates the numeric identifier of the section within the module layout that contains this field, used to group fields and determine their organizational placement on record forms.

custom_field.description: Indicates whether this field was defined by an administrator or developer beyond the standard module schema, rather than being a built-in system field. Possible values: `true` — the field is user-created and does not belong to the default module definition; `false` — the field is a standard, system-defined field.

length.description: Represents the maximum number of characters or digits permitted for this field's value, defining the storage and input boundary enforced by the CRM when records are saved.

column_name.description: Represents the underlying database column identifier mapped to this field, used for direct data-layer references and query construction within the CRM storage layer.

display_field.description: Indicates whether this field is designated as the primary display field for the module, used to represent the record in lookups, related lists, and search results. Possible values: `true` — the field serves as the record's display identifier; `false` — the field is not the primary display field.

pick_list_values_sorted_lexically.description: Indicates whether the picklist options for this field are automatically sorted in alphabetical order for display, rather than in the administrator-defined sequence order. Possible values: `true` — options are sorted alphabetically; `false` — options appear in the order defined by the administrator.

sortable.description: Indicates whether records can be sorted by this field's value in list views, reports, and search results. Possible values: `true` — the field is available as a sort key; `false` — the field cannot be used for sorting.

sequence_number.description: Represents the ordinal position of this field within its containing section, controlling the order in which fields are rendered on record forms. Sequence numbering generally starts from one but may contain gaps.

data_type.description: Identifies the data category assigned to the field, such as text, integer, decimal, date, Boolean, picklist, or lookup, which governs validation rules, storage format, and applicable UI controls.

static_field.description: Indicates whether this field is a static layout element with a fixed value that does not accept user input. Possible values: `true` — the field is a static display-only element; `false` — the field accepts dynamic user-entered or system-computed values.

hipaa_compliance_enabled.description: Indicates whether HIPAA compliance enforcement is active for this field, determining whether the associated HIPAA access and export restrictions are applied at runtime. Possible values: `true` — HIPAA compliance rules are enforced for this field; `false` — HIPAA compliance is not enforced and the field is treated as non-PHI data.

mass_update.description: Indicates whether this field can be updated simultaneously across multiple records using the mass update operation. Possible values: `true` — the field is available for mass update; `false` — the field cannot be modified through bulk update actions.

quick_sequence_number.description: Represents the ordinal position of this field in the quick-create form layout, determining the display order of fields when users create records through abbreviated entry panels.

category.description: Indicates the classification category of the field, used to group fields by their functional role or origin within the module layout, such as standard, custom, or system-defined categories.

blueprint_supported.description: Indicates whether the field can participate in Blueprint process definitions, enabling it to be referenced in transition conditions and actions within automated workflow stages. Possible values: `true` — the field is eligible for use in Blueprint configurations; `false` — the field cannot be included in Blueprint process logic.

enable_record_category.description: Indicates if the record category feature is enabled for this picklist field. Only returned when the record category feature is available.

enable_transition_for_record_category.description: Indicates if transitions between record categories are enabled. Only returned when enable_record_category is true.

record_category_values.description: List of record category values defined for this picklist field. Only returned when enable_record_category is true.

sign_in_order.description:
Indicates whether recipients must act on the document in a specified sequence.
Possible values:
**true** - The document first goes for approval, then for signing in the defined order.
**false** - Zoho Sign sends the document to all recipients simultaneously.

signers.description:
The details of the users you want to sign the document.
- recipient_name **string, mandatory** - the name of the user who has to sign or approve the document.
- **action_type** string, mandatory - the type of action you want the user to perform. The possible values are sign to **sign** the document, and **approve** to approve the document.
- **recipient** JSON object, mandatory
    - **value** string, mandatory - the email ID of the user who has to sign or approve the document.

> **Note**
> The values for the fields **recipient_name** and **recipient.value** will be taken from the mail merge template. If you want to override the values in the template, you must specify the values of these fields in the input body.

duplicate_check_fields.description:
Specifies the fields used to check for duplicate records during an Upsert operation. Duplicate check fields can be system-defined unique fields or user-defined unique fields.  
The following are the system-defined duplicate check fields for the respective modules: Leads - "Email"; Accounts - "Account_Name"; Contacts - "Email"; Deals - "Deal_Name"; Campaigns - "Campaign_Name"; Cases - "Subject"; Solutions - "Solution_Title"; Products - "Product_Name"; Vendors - "Vendor_Name"; PriceBooks - "Price_Book_Name"; Quotes - "Subject"; SalesOrders - "Subject"; PurchaseOrders - "Subject"; Invoices - "Subject"; Custom Modules - "Name".
If a matching record is found based on these fields, the record is updated; otherwise, a new record is inserted.

This key must be provided parallel to the data key. Supported for all modules where assignment rules are applicable, such as Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts, Tasks, Cases, and Custom.

apply_feature_execution.description: Use the "apply_feature_execution" array to trigger supported CRM features when creating or updating a record through the API. Specify "layout_rules" to apply layout rules or "criteria_validation_rule" to trigger validation rules. For "layout_rules", ensure the request includes all fields required by the layout rule criteria; otherwise, the API returns an error. For "criteria_validation_rule", all applicable validation rules are evaluated, and the API returns "MULTIPLE_OR_MULTI_ERRORS" if multiple rules fail.

skip_feature_execution.description: Use the "skip_feature_execution" array to skip Cadences execution when creating a record through the API. Specify "cadences" as the value of the "name" key and include this key alongside "data" in the request.

trigger.description: Specifies the CRM features to execute for the API request. Supported values are "workflow", "approval", and "blueprint". If the "trigger" parameter is not specified, workflows, approvals, and blueprints related to the API are executed. Specify an empty array [] to prevent these features from executing.

RecordEqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

RecordNotEqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

RecordEqualityFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

RecordTextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

RecordOrderingFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

RecordBetweenFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).

x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.

RelatedRecordsEqualFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

RelatedRecordsNotEqualFilterCriterionReq.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

RelatedRecordsEqualityFilterCriterionReq.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

RelatedRecordsTextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

RelatedRecordsOrderingFilterCriterionReq.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

RelatedRecordsBetweenFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

RelatedRecordsSetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

RelatedRecordsMultiSelectLookupFilterCri.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

RelatedRecordsSimpleFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

RelatedRecordsGroupedFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

RelatedRecordsFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. TerritoriesSimpleFilterCriterionValueGen.description:
Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

TerritoriesSimpleFilterCriterionValueDat.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

TerritoriesEqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

TerritoriesNotEqualFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

TerritoriesEqualityFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

TerritoriesTextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

TerritoriesOrderingFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

TerritoriesBetweenFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

TerritoriesSetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

TerritoriesMultiSelectLookupFilterCriter.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

TerritoriesSimpleFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
