TerritoriesEqualityFilterCriterionRespon.description: Represents the response for an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionResponse or NotEqualFilterCriterionResponse schema based on the comparator value.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the text filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

TerritoriesTextFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value is a string scalar or array; SimpleFilterCriterionValueString applies to text-based field types.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the ordering filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

TerritoriesOrderingFilterCriterionRespon.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value is a scalar; arrays and objects are not valid.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field was evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the between filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

TerritoriesBetweenFilterCriterionRespons.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the between and not_between comparators. The value is an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values returned for the set comparison.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the set filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

TerritoriesSetFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the in and not_in comparators. The value is an array of primitive values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references returned for the multi-select comparison.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the multi-select lookup filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

TerritoriesMultiSelectLookupFilterCriter.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the equal filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

TerritoriesSimpleFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a simple field-based filter criterion, dispatching to the appropriate comparator-specific response schema.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the grouped filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable condition within the group.

TerritoriesGroupedFilterCriterionRespons.description: Represents the grouped filter criterion returned in the response, containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the nature of the error returned by the API.

TerritoriesFilterNotSupportedApiName.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter criterion references a field API name that is not supported for filtering. The details object identifies the unsupported field and its location within the filter parameter.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the empty filter object error.

TerritoriesFilterEmptyFilterObject.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter object is submitted without any recognized fields — such as group or criteria — where at least one is required for the expression to be valid. The error code is EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.

message.description: Contains a brief error message describing which mandatory field was not found in the filter criteria.

TerritoriesFilterMandatoryNotFound.description: Represents an error response returned when a mandatory field required by the filter criteria is absent from the request. Includes a filter-specific param_name field that extends the standard MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error structure.

message.description: Contains a descriptive summary of the invalid-comparator error, identifying the rejected operator and the affected filter parameter.

TerritoriesFilterInvalidComparator.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field is provided with a comparator operator that is not supported for that field. The error code is INVALID_DATA.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the missing comparator value error.

TerritoriesFilterFieldComparatorValueMis.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field that requires a comparator value is submitted without one, typically because a required upstream dependee field is absent from the filter expression.

message.description: Represents a short, descriptive summary of the comparator-field dependency violation.

TerritoriesFilterFieldComparatorMismatch.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field's comparator value does not match any of the values permitted by the upstream dependee field's value. Contains the offending field's API name and JSONPath location, the dependee field's identity, the filter parameter context, and the list of supported comparator values.

message.description: Contains a descriptive explanation of the filter field value mismatch error.

TerritoriesFilterFieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter field's value carries a data type that does not satisfy the requirement imposed by its dependee field's current value.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message summarizing the comparator-value mismatch encountered in the filter request.

TerritoriesFilterComparatorValueMismatch.description: Represents an error returned when a value associated with a filter comparator fails validation due to constraints imposed by a dependee field. This error targets the value driven by the comparator rather than the comparator operator selection itself.

message.description: Represents a descriptive message explaining the data type error encountered for the filter parameter.

TerritoriesFilterInvalidParamDataType.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter parameter is supplied with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, and details identifying the offending parameter along with its expected data type.

message.description: Represents a brief description of the data type error encountered for the filter field.

FilterInvalidFieldDataType.description: Represents the error response returned when a field within the filter criteria contains a value of an incorrect data type. Includes the API name of the offending field, its JSONPath location within the filter expression, and the data type the field expects.

message.description: Contains a brief error message describing why the specified field is not supported in the filter criteria.

FilterFieldNotSupportedInCriteria.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter criteria field references a field type that is not supported for filtering, such as file upload or image upload fields.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the invalid data type failure in a form suitable for display or logging.

TerritoriesInvalidDataType.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion field value is provided with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, the response status, and details identifying the offending field and its expected data type.

message.description: Error message describing the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING condition returned in the response envelope.

TerritoriesFieldComparatorValueMissing.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion comparator cannot be applied because the comparator value supplied by the dependee field is absent. Carries error code DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING along with details identifying both the field in error and the dependee field whose value is missing.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the comparator mismatch condition for the criterion field.

TerritoriesFieldComparatorMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value supplied for a criterion field does not match the valid comparator values determined by its dependee field. Contains the error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and a details object identifying the criterion field, its dependee field, and the list of supported comparator values.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the field value mismatch error.

TerritoriesFieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when the data type of the value supplied for a criterion field does not match the expected data type determined by the dependee field. Returned with error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Contains details identifying the mismatched criterion field, its dependee field, and the expected data type.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the comparator value mismatch error.

TerritoriesComparatorValueMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value itself does not satisfy the dependency validation rules imposed by the dependee field. Carries error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and includes details identifying the criterion field with the invalid comparator value, its dependee field (api_name, json_path), and the criterion field own api_name and json_path.

message.description: Descriptive error message conveying the nature of the invalid comparator condition to the caller.

TerritoriesInvalidComparator.description: Error schema returned when the comparator specified in a criterion field is not one of the allowed comparator values for the given field type. Returned with error code INVALID_DATA. The details object identifies the offending field by API name and JSON path, and enumerates the supported comparator values.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message explaining why the lookup field limit was exceeded.

TerritoriesLookupLimitExceeded.description: Represents the error response returned when the count of lookup fields used in criterion expressions exceeds the allowed limit. The error code is LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The details object contains a used_in array (minItems: 1, maxItems: 10) in which each entry identifies an affected location by name and provides the relevant lookup fields and the applicable lookup limit.

message.description: Represents the error message describing why the criterion field API name is not supported by the target module.

NotSupportedApiName.description: Represents the error response returned when the API name specified in a criterion field is not supported by the target module. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, the response status, and details identifying the unsupported field and its location in the request body.

FieldNotSupportedInCriteria.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion field type is not supported in filter criteria. Field types such as file upload and image upload cannot be used as filter criteria fields. The error code is INVALID_DATA. The details object identifies the unsupported field via its api_name and json_path.

message.description: Error message describing the mandatory field not found condition returned in the response envelope.

TerritoriesMandatoryNotFound.description: Error schema returned when a mandatory criterion field is absent from the request. The error code MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND is issued, and the details object identifies the missing field via its api_name and json_path properties.

WebhookRequestBody.description:
Represents the request body configuration for the outgoing webhook request. For type **form_data**, provide form_data_content with module_parameters and custom_parameters; format may be null. 

For type **raw**, supply raw_data_content and a format value of JSON, XML, Text, or HTML. For type **none**, the body carries no content and format may be null.
WebhookRequestBody.x-zs-llm-description: Configures the webhook request body; type and format are required for all variants. For type=form_data: supply form_data_content with module_parameters and custom_parameters sub-arrays; format may be null. For type=raw: supply raw_data_content (a string) and a format value of JSON, XML, Text, or HTML note the field is raw_data_content, not data, and format, not content_type. For type=none: the body carries no content and format may be null, but the field must still be present. Example form_data: {"type":"form_data","format":null,"form_data_content":{"module_parameters":[{"name":"Lead_Source","value":"${!Leads.Lead_Source}"}],"custom_parameters":[{"name":"key","value":"val"}]}}. Example (raw): {"type":"raw","format":"JSON","raw_data_content":"{\"lead\":\"${!Leads.Full_Name}\"}"}.

All required fields (name, module, url, http_method, authentication, feature_type) must be included partial updates are not supported. Module is immutable and returns NOT_ALLOWED if changed. System-managed read-only fields must be omitted.

InvalidWebhookIdPathError.description: Represents the error returned when the webhook ID in the URL path is invalid or does not match an existing webhook.
InvalidWebhookIdPathError.x-zs-llm-description: The webhook ID in the URL path is invalid or does not exist.

BulkDeleteReadOnlyNotAllowedError.description: Represents the error entry in a bulk delete response when a webhook in the request is read-only and cannot be deleted.
BulkDeleteReadOnlyNotAllowedError.x-zs-llm-description: Bulk delete entry failed the webhook is read-only and cannot be deleted.

BulkDeleteAssociatedNotAllowedError.description: Represents the error entry in a bulk delete response when a webhook in the request is associated with active automation rules and cannot be deleted.
BulkDeleteAssociatedNotAllowedError.x-zs-llm-description: Bulk delete entry failed the webhook is associated with rules and cannot be deleted.

AutomationUsageResource.title: Automation Usage Resource

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the automation action, such as an email notification ID or a webhook ID.

name.description: Represents the display name of the automation action. Falls back to the name recorded in the automation audit log when the action has been deleted.

layout_id.description: Represents the identifier of the wizard layout associated with the automation action. Present only when the include_inner_details query parameter is set to resource.layout_id and the action is linked to a wizard layout.

AutomationUsageResource.description: Represents a reference to the specific automation action that generated usage. The identifier and name are resolved from the action's configuration record; for deleted actions, the name falls back to the corresponding automation audit log entry. When the include_inner_details parameter includes resource.layout_id and the action is associated with a wizard layout, a layout_id field is included in the representation.

AutomationUsageDataEntry.title: Automation Usage Data Entry

date.description: Represents the date of this usage data point in YYYY-MM-DD format. All dates are evaluated in the organization's time zone.

count.description: Represents the number of times the automation action was executed on this date. When the group_by parameter is set to 'date' only, this value reflects the total across all actions.

type.description: Represents the automation feature type associated with the reported executions. Values correspond to the filter types supported by the type query parameter, such as workflow_rules, approval_process, Blueprint, email_notifications, webhooks, and kiosks.

AutomationUsageDataEntry.description: Represents a single daily usage data point capturing the execution count for an automation action. When the group_by parameter includes resource, the embedded resource object identifies the individual email notification or webhook. When group_by is date only, the resource object is omitted and the count reflects total executions across all actions for that day. The type field indicates the automation feature responsible for the executions, such as workflow_rules, approval_process, or Blueprint.

AutomationUsagePaginationInfo.title: Automation Usage Pagination Info

per_page.description: Represents the number of records returned in each page of the result set.

count.description: Represents the number of records included in the current page of results.

page.description: Represents the one-based index of the current page within the paginated result set.

more_records.description:
Indicates whether additional pages of results are available beyond the current page.
Possible values:
true - More records exist beyond the current page.
false - The current page contains the last records.

max_limit.description: Represents the edition-specific daily execution cap for the automation action type. For email notifications, this reflects the WORKFLOWALERT day limit; for webhooks, it reflects the WFWEBHOOK day limit. Lower-tier editions carry smaller caps.

AutomationUsagePaginationInfo.description: Represents pagination metadata returned with automation usage report responses. Includes a max_limit value that reflects the edition-specific daily execution cap for the relevant action type, derived from the organization's feature limits.

AutomationUsageReportResponse.title: Automation Usage Report Response

data_usage.description: Contains the collection of usage data points for the queried period. Each entry represents the execution count for a specific automation action on a given date. Returns an empty array when no usage exists for the queried period.

AutomationUsageReportResponse.description: Represents a successful response from an automation usage report endpoint. Contains an array of daily usage data points alongside pagination metadata that includes the edition-specific daily execution cap. When no usage exists for the queried period, the endpoint returns an empty data array rather than null, and the response resolves with HTTP 200.

AutomationUsageRequiredParamMissingError.title: Automation Usage Required Param Missing Error

message.description: Represents a descriptive message explaining the error that caused the request to fail.
message.example: One of the expected param is missing

AutomationUsageRequiredParamMissingError.description: Represents the error structure returned when the group_by query parameter is omitted from the request. All automation usage report endpoints require group_by to be present and to include date as a mandatory grouping dimension.

AutomationUsageInvalidDataError.title: Automation Usage Invalid Data Error

message.description: Represents a descriptive message explaining the error that caused the request to fail.

AutomationUsageInvalidDataError.description: Represents the error envelope returned when an invalid value is supplied for a usage report query parameter. The details object identifies which parameter is invalid. Common causes include an unsupported type filter value, an invalid group_by combination, a malformed date, an invalid sort_order, or a non-numeric page or per_page value.

AutomationUsageNoPermissionError.title: Automation Usage No Permission Error

message.description: Represents a descriptive message explaining the error that caused the request to fail.

AutomationUsageNoPermissionError.description: Represents the error structure returned when the authenticated user lacks the required Manage Automation Actions privilege, or when the requested feature — email notifications or webhooks — is not available in the organization's current edition.

GetworkflowconfigurationsResponse200.title: Workflow Configurations Response
GetworkflowconfigurationsResponse200.description: Response containing workflow configurations for a module including available triggers, actions, and related trigger details.
GetworkflowconfigurationsResponse200.x-zs-llm-description: Use this response as the container for workflow configuration metadata returned for the requested module.

WorkflowConfigurationsMetadata.title: Workflow Configurations Metadata

related_triggers_details.description: List of related modules (e.g., Notes, Calls, Activities) whose record events can trigger workflow rules on the parent module. Each entry contains the related module's identity and available trigger types.
related_triggers_details.x-zs-llm-description: Use this list only when a workflow rule should be triggered by events from a related module rather than the primary module.

triggers.description: Represents the list of trigger types available for the module. Each entry defines an event that can initiate a workflow rule, along with the action types supported for that trigger (for example, create, edit, delete, field_update, date_or_datetime).
triggers.x-zs-llm-description: Use each trigger api_name as the execute_when type when creating or updating workflow rules.

actions.description: List of available action types for the module. Each action defines an operation that can be performed when the workflow rule fires, along with its per-type limit (applies independently to instant_actions and scheduled_actions), scheduling support, and whether it is an associate action (reusable entity referenced by ID) or non-associate action (defined inline).
actions.x-zs-llm-description: Use this list to validate action types and limits before selecting instant or scheduled actions for a workflow rule.

WorkflowConfigurationsMetadata.description: Configuration metadata for workflows on a specific module. Contains three sections: triggers (events that fire the rule), actions (operations available when the rule fires with their per-type limits and scheduling support), and related_triggers_details (child/related modules like Notes or Calls whose events can also trigger rules on the parent module).
WorkflowConfigurationsMetadata.x-zs-llm-description: Use this schema to understand which triggers and action types can be used when composing workflow rule requests for the module.

WorkflowConfigurationsTrigger.title: Workflow Configurations Trigger

api_name.description: Represents the API identifier of the trigger type. Use this value in the execute_when.type field when creating a workflow rule (for example, create, edit, create_or_edit, delete, field_update, section_update, date_or_datetime, score_increase, score_decrease, score_update).
api_name.x-zs-llm-description: Use this value as the trigger type identifier in workflow rule payloads.

deprecated.description:
Indicates whether this trigger type is deprecated.
Possible values:
true - The trigger type is deprecated and should not be used for new workflow rules, though it may still appear on existing rules.
false - The trigger type is active and available for use.

name.description: Represents the display name of the trigger type as shown in the CRM UI (for example, Create, Edit, FieldUpdate, DateBased).

scheduled_actions_supported.description:
Indicates whether this trigger type supports scheduled (time-delayed) actions.
Possible values:
true - Both instant_actions and scheduled_actions are available for workflow rules with this trigger.
false - Only instant_actions can be used in workflow rules with this trigger.

items.description: Represents an action type API name supported by this trigger (for example, field_updates, email_notifications, webhooks, assign_owner, add_tags, remove_tags, create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, functions, flow).

actions.description: Represents the list of action type API names supported by this trigger. Only these action types can be used in workflow rules with this trigger type. Cross-reference with the top-level actions array in the response for full action metadata, including per-type limits and scheduling support.
actions.x-zs-llm-description: Use these values to restrict workflow actions to the action types supported by the selected trigger.

component_id.description: Represents the component identifier for marketplace or custom triggers. Returns null for standard built-in trigger types.

generated_type.description: Represents the generated type identifier for marketplace or custom triggers. Returns null for standard built-in trigger types.

WorkflowConfigurationsTrigger.description: A trigger type available for the module. Defines the event that initiates a workflow rule. Use the api_name value in the execute_when.type field when creating or updating a workflow rule via POST/PUT /settings/automation/workflow_rules.
WorkflowConfigurationsTrigger.x-zs-llm-description: Use this object to choose a workflow trigger and to know which action api_names are compatible with that trigger.

WorkflowConfigurationsAction.title: Workflow Configurations Action

is_clickable.description: Indicates whether this action type can be edited directly from the workflow configuration UI page. Not relevant for API usage.

associate_action.description:
Indicates whether this action type is an associate action. Associate actions link or associate records between modules (for example, linking a Contact to a Deal or associating a Product with an Order). Associate actions differ from standard data-write actions such as field_updates or email_notifications.
Possible values: **true** - This action type is an associate action. **false** - This action type is a standard non-associate action.
associate_action.x-zs-llm-description: When true, reference an existing reusable automation entity by ID instead of defining the action inline.

limit_per_action.description: Represents the maximum number of items within a single action instance. For example, add_tags and remove_tags allow a maximum of 10 tags per action. Returns null if no per-action item limit applies.
limit_per_action.x-zs-llm-description: Use this as the maximum number of items inside one action instance when the value is not null.

api_name.description: Represents the API identifier of the action type used when creating or modifying workflow rules (for example, field_updates, email_notifications, webhooks, assign_owner, add_tags, remove_tags, create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, functions, flow).

supported_in_scheduled_action.description: Indicates whether this action type can be used as a scheduled (time-delayed) action in a workflow rule. **Possible values:** true - This action type is supported in scheduled_actions (for example, time-delayed email_notifications or field_updates). false - This action type is only supported in instant_actions.
supported_in_scheduled_action.x-zs-llm-description: When false, do not place this action type inside scheduled_actions.

name.description: Represents the display name of the action type as shown in the CRM UI.

limit.description: Maximum number of instances of this action type allowed per workflow rule. Applies independently to instant_actions and scheduled_actions - for instance, if limit=5, you can add up to 5 instances in instant_actions and up to 5 in scheduled_actions. Returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED if exceeded.
limit.x-zs-llm-description: Use this as the maximum number of action instances of this type allowed in instant_actions and separately in scheduled_actions.

WorkflowConfigurationsAction.description: Represents an action type available for the module. Defines an operation that can be performed when a workflow rule triggers. The limit field is the per-type cap that applies independently to instant_actions and scheduled_actions - for instance, if limit=5, you can add up to 5 instances in instant_actions and up to 5 in scheduled_actions of the same rule.
WorkflowConfigurationsAction.x-zs-llm-description: Use this object to choose an action type and understand whether it is reusable, schedulable, and how many instances are allowed.

WorkflowConfigurationsRelatedTriggerDeta.title: Workflow Configurations Related Trigger Detail

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the related module that can act as a trigger source (for example, Notes, Tasks, Events, Attachments). Use this value to identify the related module when creating workflow rules that should fire on related record events.

name.description: Represents the display name of the related module.

triggers.description: Represents the list of trigger types available from this related module. These triggers can be used in workflow rules on the parent module via the execute_when.details.trigger_module field.
triggers.x-zs-llm-description: Use these trigger definitions with execute_when details when the trigger source is a related module.

WorkflowConfigurationsRelatedTriggerDeta.description: Represents a related module that can act as a trigger source for the parent module's workflow rules. For example, when a user creates a Note on a Lead record, a workflow rule on the Leads module configured with a Notes-related trigger fires.
WorkflowConfigurationsRelatedTriggerDeta.x-zs-llm-description: Use this object when configuring workflows that react to events from related modules.

ModuleReference.title: Module Reference

singular_label.description: Represents the singular display name of the module as shown in the CRM UI (for example, Lead, Contact, Deal).

plural_label.description: Represents the plural display name of the module as shown in the CRM UI (for example, Leads, Contacts, Deals).

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the CRM module used in API requests (for example, Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts, Tasks, Cases, Products, Quotes, Sales_Orders, Invoices, Campaigns, Vendors).

name.description: Represents the internal name of the CRM module.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the CRM module.

ModuleReference.description: Represents a CRM module with its identity and display labels, including its API name, singular and plural display labels, unique ID, and internal name.
ModuleReference.x-zs-llm-description: Use api_name or id from this object when another workflow API requires a module identifier.

WorkflowConfigurationsRequiredParamMissi.title: Required Param Missing Error

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

WorkflowConfigurationsRequiredParamMissi.description: Represents the error response when the required module query parameter is omitted from the request.

InvalidModuleResponse.title: Invalid Module Error

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.
message.example: The value provided to the param is Invalid

InvalidModuleResponse.description: Represents the error response when the module query parameter value does not correspond to a valid CRM module or a workflow-supported module.

WorkflowConfigurationsNoPermissionError.title: No Permission Error

message.description: Represents the permission error message describing the issue.
message.example: feature not available in this edition

WorkflowConfigurationsNoPermissionError.description: Represents the error response when the user lacks the required Manage Automation Actions privilege or when the workflow feature is unavailable in the current CRM edition.

workflow_rules.description: Represents the array of workflow rule objects returned in the success response.

WorkflowSuccessSchema.description: Represents the success response returned after creating a workflow rule, containing the result details of the created rule.
WorkflowSuccessSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Success response wrapper for POST/PUT workflow rule operations. Contains workflow_rules array with per-rule status objects indicating success or failure with details.

reorder.description: Represents the array of workflow rule objects with their updated execution order.

ReOrderSuccessResponseSchema.description: Represents the success response returned after reordering workflow rules.
ReOrderSuccessResponseSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Success response wrapper for the reorderWorkflowRules operation. Contains reorder array confirming the new execution sequence was applied.

NoPermissionSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.
message.example: feature not available in this edition

NoPermissionSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when the authenticated user does not have permission to access the requested feature or module.
NoPermissionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error codes: NO_PERMISSION or FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED. Returned when the user lacks ManageAutomation permission or the workflow feature is not available in the current CRM edition. Resolution: verify user permissions and edition capabilities.

code.description: Represents the API response code indicating the operation result, such as **SUCCESS** or **INVALID_DATA**.

status.description: Represents the response status indicator, such as **success** or **error**.

SuccessResponseNestedSchema.description: Represents a single item in a multi-status response array, including a response code, status indicator, message, and optionally the resource details.
SuccessResponseNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Individual success/error status object within a bulk operation response. Contains code (status code string), details (object with created/updated resource id), message (human-readable), and status ('success' or 'error').

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the SuccessResponseDetails within the workflow rule.

SuccessResponseDetailsSchema.description: Represents the details object within a success response, containing the unique ID of the created or updated resource.
SuccessResponseDetailsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Details object within a success response item. Contains id of the created or updated workflow rule resource.

DependentFieldMissingSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

DependentFieldMissingSchema.description: Error code DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING occurs when: action details are missing or empty, assign_owner resource is omitted, scheduled_actions execute_after lacks period or unit, or field_update lookup_field is not provided. To fix, check the action type's required companion fields and include all of them.
DependentFieldMissingSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING. Returned when: (1) action details object is missing or empty, (2) assign_owner type is set but resource is omitted, (3) scheduled_actions execute_after missing period/unit, (4) field_update lookup_field needed but not provided. Fix: check the action type's required companion fields and provide all of them.

ExpectedFieldMissingSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

ExpectedFieldMissingSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when required fields such as the module API name and ID are missing from the request.
ExpectedFieldMissingSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING. Returned when a required identifier object (module, field) is provided but missing its expected keys. Typically: module object present but both api_name and id are absent. Fix: provide at least one identifier (api_name or id) in the reference object.

LimitExceededSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

LimitExceededSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when a configured limit, such as the maximum number of conditions or actions per rule, is exceeded.
LimitExceededSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error codes: LIMIT_EXCEEDED or LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. LIMIT_EXCEEDED: org has reached maximum rules, conditions, or actions per rule  -  check getWorkflowRulesCount for limits. LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: too many lookup-based field_update actions. Resolution: remove unused rules/actions or upgrade plan.

DependentMisMatchSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

DependentMisMatchSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when **module_selection** is set to a value that requires a specific module but no module is provided.
DependentMisMatchSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Returned when a field's value conflicts with its controlling field. Common cases: (1) module_selection is 'all' but relational_criteria is provided (should be 'specific'), (2) trigger type doesn't support scheduled_actions but they're included, (3) repeat=true with scheduled actions. Fix: align dependent values with their parent field's constraints.

AmbiguityDuringProcessingSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.
message.example: action not supported for this trigger

AmbiguityDuringProcessingSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when the system encounters ambiguity during processing due to conflicting field references.
AmbiguityDuringProcessingSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Returned when two identifying fields point to different entities. Common cases: (1) module.api_name and module.id refer to different modules, (2) associate action created for wrong module vs module_selection context, (3) add_tags/remove_tags used alongside convert on Leads. Fix: ensure all identifiers are consistent and refer to the same entity.

UrlIdMissingSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.
message.example: the id given seems to be invalid

UrlIdMissingSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when the workflow rule ID provided in the URL path is invalid or does not match an existing record.
UrlIdMissingSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error codes: INVALID_DATA or NOT_ALLOWED. Returned for path-parameter validation failures. INVALID_DATA: the ID in the URL path is malformed or does not exist. NOT_ALLOWED: operation not permitted on the specified resource (e.g., deleting a locked rule). Fix: verify the rule ID exists via getWorkflowRules before using it in path.

AlreadyUsedSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

AlreadyUsedSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when the resource or value you are trying to create already exists in the system.
AlreadyUsedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: ALREADY_USED. Returned when attempting to create a workflow rule with a name that already exists in the same module, or adding a duplicate action entry. Fix: use a unique name or update the existing rule instead of creating a duplicate.

CannotRemoveSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

CannotRemoveSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when a delete operation would leave required data empty or remove a resource that is still in use.
CannotRemoveSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: CANNOT_REMOVE. Returned when a delete operation would leave required data empty. Most common: attempting to remove the last remaining action from a condition via PUT with _delete=null. A rule must always have at least one action per condition. Fix: delete the entire condition or rule instead of removing its last action.

RequiredDataNotFoundSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.
message.example: Kindly provide values for the required fields

RequiredDataNotFoundSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when required data referenced in the request, such as a module, field, or action entity, cannot be found in the system.
RequiredDataNotFoundSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Returned when mandatory body data is completely missing. Common: field_mappings values required for action details (create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call) but not provided, or mandatory module fields not included in field_mappings array. Fix: include all mandatory fields in the request.

FeatureDisabledSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

FeatureDisabledSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when a feature required by the workflow rule configuration is currently disabled in the organization.
FeatureDisabledSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: FEATURE_DISABLED. Returned when the feature required by the workflow rule is turned off at the org level (e.g., VoC disabled, social integrations disabled). Resolution: enable the feature in CRM settings or remove the action that requires it.

FailureSchema.title: Error Response Core

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

FailureSchema.description: Represents a generic failure response returned when an unexpected error occurs during workflow rule creation or update.
FailureSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error code: FAILURE. Generic backend failure during rule creation or update. Not caused by invalid input  -  indicates an unexpected server-side error. Resolution: retry the request. If persistent, the rule configuration may be triggering an edge case  -  simplify and retry incrementally.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the issue.

InvalidDataNoApiNameAndPathSchema.description: Represents the error response returned when a required parameter such as the module API name or field path is missing from the request.
InvalidDataNoApiNameAndPathSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Error codes: REQUIRED_PARAM_MISSING, INVALID_DATA, NOT_ALLOWED, INVALID_MODULE, or INVALID_REQUEST. Catch-all for request-level validation failures. REQUIRED_PARAM_MISSING: mandatory query/path param absent. INVALID_MODULE: module doesn't support workflow rules. INVALID_REQUEST: malformed JSON or structural issue. Fix: verify all required parameters and request structure.

workflow_rules.description: Represents the array containing the workflow rule object to create. The array must contain exactly one object per request.

PostWorkflowRuleSchema.description: Represents the request body wrapper for creating a new workflow rule. Contains a single-element array with the workflow rule configuration.
PostWorkflowRuleSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Top-level request body for POST /settings/automation/workflow_rules. Contains a single-element workflow_rules array. The rule object structure is defined in WorkflowRulePostNestedSchema.

name.description: Specify the workflow rule name. Required. Cannot exceed 100 characters. Special characters are not allowed.

description.description: Specify an optional description for the workflow rule. Set to null to clear an existing description.

conditions.description: Specify the conditions that define the branching logic of the workflow rule. Each condition evaluates records against criteria and executes its own set of actions. At least one condition is required.

WorkflowRulePostNestedSchema.description: Represents the configuration object for a new workflow rule, including required fields such as name, target module, and trigger configuration.
WorkflowRulePostNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: The rule object for creating a workflow rule. Required fields: name (max 100 chars), module ({api_name, id}), execute_when (trigger config), conditions (array with actions). Optional: description (max 1000), lock ({status, message}). Must call getWorkflowConfigurations before constructing to validate trigger and action availability for the module.

workflow_rules.description: The request body must contain a **workflow_rules** array with one object.

UpdateWorkflowRuleSchema.description: Represents the request body wrapper for updating an existing workflow rule. Contains a single-element array with the updated rule configuration.
UpdateWorkflowRuleSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Top-level request body for PUT /settings/automation/workflow_rules (bulk update). Contains workflow_rules array with exactly 1 rule object that must include its id for identification.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the workflow rule to update. Required.

name.description: Specify the workflow rule name. Required.

description.description: Specify the workflow rule description.

conditions.description: Specify the array of condition objects to update. On update, unspecified conditions are preserved. Conditions with a null ID are added; conditions with an existing ID get replaced; conditions with a **_delete** flag are removed.

WorkflowRulePutNestedSchema.description: Represents the configuration object for updating an existing workflow rule, including the rule ID and optional fields such as name, trigger, conditions, and lock status.
WorkflowRulePutNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Rule object inside the PUT request body. All fields are optional for partial update: id (required for identification in bulk PUT), name, description, status ({active: bool}), execute_when (trigger), conditions (actions), lock, module. Omitted fields retain their current values.

WorkflowRulesGetResponseSchema.title: Workflow Rule List Response

workflow_rules.description: Represents the array of workflow rule objects returned in the list response.

WorkflowRulesGetResponseSchema.description: Represents the paginated list response for workflow rules, containing an array of workflow rule objects and pagination metadata.
WorkflowRulesGetResponseSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Response wrapper for getWorkflowRules (list). Contains workflow_rules array of rule objects and info object with pagination metadata (page, per_page, count, more_records).

WorkflowRuleSingleGetResponseSchema.title: Workflow Rule List Response

workflow_rules.description: Represents the array containing the single workflow rule retrieved.

WorkflowRuleSingleGetResponseSchema.description: Represents the response body for a single workflow rule retrieval, containing a single-element array with the full rule details.
WorkflowRuleSingleGetResponseSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Response wrapper for getWorkflowRuleById. Contains workflow_rules array with exactly one complete rule object.

WorkflowRuleSingleGetSchema.title: Workflow Rule

created_time.description: Represents the ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the system created this workflow rule.

editable.description: Indicates whether the requesting user has permission to edit this workflow rule.

deprecated.description: Indicates whether this workflow rule is deprecated and should be migrated to a newer configuration.

deletable.description: Indicates whether the requesting user has permission to delete this workflow rule.

description.description: Represents the user-defined description of the workflow rule. Null if not set.

source.description: Represents the origin of the workflow rule. For example, **crm** for rules created through the CRM UI, or **API** for rules created through the API.

last_executed_time.description: Represents the ISO 8601 timestamp of the last time this workflow rule was triggered. Null if the rule has never been triggered.

name.description: Represents the name of the workflow rule.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the workflow rule.

category.description: Represents the classification category of the workflow rule.

conditions.description: Represents the array of condition objects that define the criteria for executing the actions of the workflow rule.

WorkflowRuleSingleGetSchema.description: Represents the full configuration and metadata of a single workflow rule, including its trigger, conditions, actions, lock status, and audit timestamps.
WorkflowRuleSingleGetSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Complete workflow rule entity as returned in GET responses. Contains all rule metadata: trigger (execute_when), conditions with actions, module reference, ownership (created_by, modified_by), timestamps, lock status, activation status, and capabilities (editable, deletable, deprecated). Use this to understand current rule state before updating.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the module or field, such as **Leads**, **Contacts**, or a custom field API name.

id.description: Represents the unique numeric ID of the module or field.

ModuleOrFieldNestedSchema.description: Represents a CRM module or field reference using its API name and unique numeric ID.
ModuleOrFieldNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Reusable reference object for modules and fields. Both api_name and id must be provided  -  API returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND if id is missing. Used across: rule module, action module, criteria field, field_mappings field, lookup_field.

ExecuteWhenNestedSchema.description: Represents the trigger configuration that defines when the workflow rule fires, including the trigger type and its associated details.
ExecuteWhenNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Trigger configuration discriminator (oneOf). The type field selects the trigger template  -  route to the matching schema: T1 (simple lifecycle/event types), T2 (field_update), T3 (section_update), T4 (date_or_datetime), T5 (time offset), T6 (score_update), T7 (mail_sent_replied_within). Not all triggers work on all modules  -  validate with getWorkflowConfigurations first.

ExecuteWhenT1Simple.description: Represents a simple trigger type (T1) that fires on record creation, editing, deletion, or when specific CRM events occur, with optional repeat and cross-module support.
ExecuteWhenT1Simple.x-zs-llm-description: Simple trigger template for record lifecycle and event types: create, edit, create_or_edit, delete, cancel, and module-specific variants (email_received, missed_call, mail_sent_*, fb_*, tw_*). Only requires details.repeat (bool). Email/call/social triggers require their dedicated module with relational_criteria linking to target module. Validate availability via getWorkflowConfigurations.

ExecuteWhenT2FieldUpdate.description: Represents a field update trigger type that fires when a specified field value on a record changes according to defined criteria.
ExecuteWhenT2FieldUpdate.x-zs-llm-description:
Field update trigger. Fires when a specific field value
changes. The monitored field is defined inside
details.criteria.field  -  not at top level. Set details.criteria.value
to '${ANYVALUE}' to fire on any change regardless of new value.
Call-prefixed variants require the Calls module. details.repeat controls
re-execution on subsequent edits. details.match_all controls
multi-criteria evaluation.

ExecuteWhenT3SectionUpdate.description: Represents the trigger type for section update rules. Availability varies by the target module
ExecuteWhenT3SectionUpdate.x-zs-llm-description: Section update trigger. Fires when any field within specific layout sections is modified. Required: details.sections (array of section objects). Call-prefixed variants require the Calls module. Validate available sections via getLayouts for the module.

ExecuteWhenT4DateBased.description: Represents the date or datetime field to monitor for triggering the rule. Must reference an existing date or datetime field on the module.
ExecuteWhenT4DateBased.x-zs-llm-description: Date-based trigger. Fires relative to a date/datetime field value (before or after). Required: details.field ({api_name, id}  -  must be date/datetime type), details.period ('days'|'hours'), details.sign ('negative' for before, 'positive' for after), details.unit (integer  -  number of days/hours). Broadly available across modules.

ExecuteWhenT5TimeOffset.description: Represents the trigger type for time-offset rules. Availability varies by the target module.
ExecuteWhenT5TimeOffset.x-zs-llm-description: Time offset trigger. Fires after a specified delay from an event. Required: details.period ('days'|'hours'), details.unit (integer). Module-specific triggers: email time-offset types (email_received_notreplied, mail_sent_notopened) require a dedicated email module with relational_criteria. 'overdue' requires an activity module. Does not support repeat.

ExecuteWhenT6ScoreUpdate.description: Represents a score update trigger type (T6) that fires when a record score changes due to configured scoring rules.
ExecuteWhenT6ScoreUpdate.x-zs-llm-description: Score update trigger. Fires when a record's score changes based on scoring rules. Required: details.type ('All_Rules' for any scoring rule, 'Selective_Rules' for specific ones). For Selective_Rules also requires details.scoring_rules array with rule IDs. Trigger types: score_increase, score_decrease, score_update, zia_scoring_rule.

ExecuteWhenT7EmailRepliedWithin.description: Represents an email-reply-window trigger type (T7) that fires when a sent email receives a reply within a configured time window.
ExecuteWhenT7EmailRepliedWithin.x-zs-llm-description:
Email replied-within trigger. Fires when a sent email
receives a reply within a time window.Required-details.period ('days'|'hours'), details.unit (integer). Only type: mail_sent_replied_within. Typically requires a dedicated email module with relational_criteria. Does not support repeat.

sequence_number.description: Represents the execution order of this condition within the workflow rule, starting from one. Must be unique across all conditions in the rule.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the condition. Auto-generated on creation. Required on PUT to identify which condition to update.

_delete.description: Indicates that this condition should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

ConditionsNestedSchema.description: Represents a single condition within a workflow rule that defines which records are evaluated and what actions are executed when the criteria are met.
ConditionsNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: A condition defines WHICH records to act on and WHAT actions to execute. Each rule has 1+ conditions evaluated in sequence_number order. Required: sequence_number (integer, starting from 1). At least one of instant_actions or scheduled_actions must be present. Optional: criteria_details (filter gate). Convert action requires criteria_details.criteria to be non-null.

CriteriaDetailsNestedSchema.description: Represents the filter criteria that determine which records satisfy the workflow rule condition.
CriteriaDetailsNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Filter configuration determining which records pass through to action execution. Contains two independent blocks: criteria (filters on trigger module's own fields) and relational_criteria (filters on a related module). Both are optional  -  null or omitted criteria matches ALL records. Required for certain triggers (related-module triggers) and for convert action.

actions.description: Represents the array of action objects configured for this condition. Required and must be non-empty. Each action object specifies the action type and its configuration or reference ID.

InstantActionsNestedSchema.description: Represents the container for instant actions that execute immediately when the workflow rule condition is met.
InstantActionsNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Container for actions that execute immediately when the condition is met. Contains actions array (non-empty required). Each action is either associate (pre-configured entity referenced by type+id) or non-associate (inline type+details). Check getWorkflowConfigurations actions[].associate_action to determine which pattern to use for each action type.

ScheduledActionsNestedSchema.description: Represents the container for scheduled actions that execute after a configured delay from the time the workflow rule condition is triggered.
ScheduledActionsNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Container for delayed action groups. Each group has execute_after ({period, unit}) defining the delay and an actions array. Not supported when: trigger has repeat=true, convert action present in instant_actions, or trigger doesn't support scheduling (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Max groups governed by getWorkflowRulesCount scheduled_actions_per_rule_limit.

id.title: Email Notification Action Id
id.description: Represents the unique ID of the email notification. Required when associating an existing email notification with the rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the EmailNotificationAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the associated action configuration.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

AssociateActionsNestedSchema.description: Represents an associate action that references a pre-configured action entity by its unique ID. Use the appropriate entity API to retrieve valid IDs.
AssociateActionsNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Union (oneOf) for pre-configured action references. Routes to: EmailNotificationAssociateActionSchema, FieldUpdateAssociateActionSchema, TaskAssociateActionSchema, or SimpleAssociateActionSchema based on type value. Associate actions reference an entity created via its own API  -  they carry type + id (and optionally related_details).

id.title: Email Notification Action Id
id.description: Represents the unique ID of the email notification. Required when associating an existing email notification with the rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the EmailNotificationAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the associated action configuration.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

EmailNotificationAssociateActionSchema.description: Represents an associate action that sends a pre-configured email notification when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
EmailNotificationAssociateActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: References a pre-configured email notification entity by ID. Create the entity first via postEmailNotifications, then use its ID here. Supports related_details.best_time for optimal send timing. Entity must be created for the correct module (main module, or relational_criteria.module if module_selection='specific' with Emails/Facebook/Twitter).

id.title: Field Update Action Id
id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field update action. Use the Get Field Updates API to retrieve available IDs.

name.description: Represents the display name of the FieldUpdateAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the referenced action configuration.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

FieldUpdateAssociateActionSchema.description: Represents an associate action that updates field values using a pre-configured field update action when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
FieldUpdateAssociateActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: References a pre-configured field update entity by ID. Create the entity first via createFieldUpdates, then use its ID here. Supports related_details.lookup_field for targeting a related module's field  -  set null for same-module updates. Entity must be created for the correct module context.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the task action. Required to associate a pre-configured task with the workflow rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the TaskAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the referenced action configuration.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

TaskAssociateActionSchema.description: Represents an associate action that creates a task based on a pre-configured task template when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
TaskAssociateActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: References a pre-configured task action entity by ID. Create the entity first via createWorkflowTasks, then use its ID here. Supports related_details.followup_details for auto-creating follow-up tasks on status change. Entity must be created for the correct module context.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the pre-configured action entity. Required to associate an existing action with the workflow rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the SimpleAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the referenced action configuration.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

SimpleAssociateActionSchema.description: Represents an associate action that references a pre-configured action entity by its unique ID, applicable to action types such as webhooks, functions, and notifications.
SimpleAssociateActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: References a pre-configured action entity (webhooks, functions, sms, whatsapp) by type and ID. No related_details supported. Create entities via: webhooks->createWebhooks, functions->Create_Functions, sms/whatsapp->postMessageNotifications. Entity must target the correct module based on module_selection context.

name.description: Represents the display name of the AssignOwner action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the AssignOwner action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

NonAssociateActionsNestedSchema.description: Represents an inline action configuration that is defined directly within the workflow rule condition, rather than referencing a pre-created action entity by ID.
NonAssociateActionsNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Union (oneOf) for inline action configurations. Routes by type to: AssignOwnerActionSchema, CreateRecordActionSchema, AddMeetingActionSchema, ScheduleCallActionSchema, AddTagsActionSchema, RemoveTagsActionSchema, ConvertActionSchema, ChatNotificationActionSchema, CircuitsActionSchema, ZohoFlowActionSchema, SocialActionSchema, EmailCreateRecordActionSchema, CreateConnectedRecordActionSchema. Each carries type + details with full inline config.

oneOf.description: Represents a null value indicating no related details are configured for this action.

best_time.description: Indicates whether to send the email notification at the best time for the recipient. When set to true, the platform determines the optimal send time.

RelatedDetailsNestedSchema.description: Represents the optional action-specific configuration attached to an associate action, such as best-time delivery settings for email notifications or lookup field references for field updates.
RelatedDetailsNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Discriminator (oneOf) for action-specific supplementary configuration. Only three action types support related_details: email_notifications (best_time delivery), tasks (followup_details), and field_updates (lookup_field for cross-module targeting). Other action types do not use related_details.

best_time.description: Indicates whether to send the email notification at the best time for the recipient. When set to true, the platform determines the optimal send time.

EmailNotificationRelatedDetailsSchema.description: Represents the optional related configuration details for email notification actions, including best-time delivery settings.
EmailNotificationRelatedDetailsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Supplementary config for email_notifications associate action. Controls best-time delivery scheduling  -  when best_time=true, the email is sent at the recipient's optimal engagement time rather than immediately.

TaskRelatedDetailsSchema.description: Represents the optional related configuration details for task actions, specifying whether and how a followup task should be created.
TaskRelatedDetailsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Supplementary config for tasks associate action. Configures automatic followup task creation based on condition/unit/period  -  creates a new followup task after the original task's status changes.

FieldUpdateRelatedDetailsSchema.description: Represents the optional related configuration details for field update actions, specifying the lookup field used for cross-module field updates.
FieldUpdateRelatedDetailsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Supplementary config for field_updates associate action. Specifies lookup_field ({api_name, id}) to target a related module's field via a lookup relationship. Set to null for same-module field updates.

name.description: Represents the name of the CRM user who created or last modified the workflow rule.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the CRM user.

CreatedModifiedByObjectSchema.description: Represents the identity details of the CRM user who created or last modified the workflow rule.
CreatedModifiedByObjectSchema.x-zs-llm-description: User reference object containing name and id. Used in GET responses for created_by and modified_by fields showing who created or last modified the workflow rule.

TimeObjectSchema.description: Represents a time offset specification combining a period label and a numeric magnitude, used in time-based workflow trigger configurations.
TimeObjectSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Timestamp object used in GET responses for created_time, modified_time, and last_executed_time fields.

LockStatusSchema.title: Lock Status

message.description: Represents the note or label indicating the reason or context for locking the rule.

status.description:
Indicates whether the workflow rule is locked.
Possible values:
true - The rule is locked.
false - The rule is not locked.

LockStatusSchema.description: Represents the lock configuration of a workflow rule, including the lock state and the identity of the user who applied the lock.
LockStatusSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Lock state of a workflow rule. Contains status (boolean  -  is currently locked), locked_by (user object), and message (lock reason string). Locked rules cannot be deleted or updated  -  returns RECORD_LOCKED error.

name.description: Represents the name of the CRM user who locked the workflow rule.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the CRM user who locked the workflow rule.

LockedByObjectSchema.description: Represents the identity of the CRM user who locked the workflow rule, including their display name and unique ID.
LockedByObjectSchema.x-zs-llm-description: User reference within lock status showing who locked the workflow rule. Contains name and id.

ActivationStatusSchema.title: Activation Status

active.description:
Indicates whether the workflow rule is currently active.

Possible values:
true - The workflow rule is active and executes its configured actions when trigger conditions are met.
false - The workflow rule is inactive and does not execute, even when trigger conditions are met.

ActivationStatusSchema.description: Represents the activation state of a workflow rule, indicating whether the rule is currently active.
ActivationStatusSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Activation state as returned in GET responses. Contains active (boolean). Used in the status property of the rule entity. To change: PUT with status.active=true/false.

WorkflowActionCountsResponseSchema.title: Workflow Action Counts Response

workflow_rules.description: Represents the array of workflow rule objects with their action count details.

WorkflowActionCountsResponseSchema.description: Represents the response body containing the action count breakdown for one or more workflow rules, grouped by condition.
WorkflowActionCountsResponseSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Response from getWorkflowRulesActionsCount. Contains workflow_rules array where each entry has rule id and conditions array with per-condition action counts split by instant and scheduled types.

WorkflowRuleActionCountGroupSchema.title: Workflow Rule Action Count Group

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the WorkflowRuleActionCountGroup within the workflow rule.

conditions.description: Represents array of condition objects containing criteria and actions for this rule.

WorkflowRuleActionCountGroupSchema.description: Represents the action count breakdown for a single workflow rule, encapsulating the rule ID and its associated condition-level action count groups.
WorkflowRuleActionCountGroupSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Single rule entry in the action counts response. Contains the rule id and conditions array listing action count summaries per condition.

WorkflowConditionActionCountSummarySchem.title: Workflow Condition Action Count Summary

sequence_number.description: Represents the execution order of this condition within the workflow rule, starting from one.

scheduled_actions.description: Represents the array of scheduled action groups configured for this condition.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the WorkflowConditionActionCountSummary within the workflow rule.

WorkflowConditionActionCountSummarySchem.description: Represents the action count summary for a single workflow rule condition, including the condition ID, sequence number, and counts for instant and scheduled actions.
WorkflowConditionActionCountSummarySchem.x-zs-llm-description: Per-condition action count breakdown. Contains sequence_number, id (condition ID), instant_actions (count by type), and scheduled_actions (count by type). Use to check slot availability.

ActionsCountSummarySchema.title: Instant Actions Count Summary

actions_count.description: Represents the list of action count entries, each categorized by action type, for the workflow rule.

ActionsCountSummarySchema.description: Represents a summary of execution count entries for instant actions in a workflow rule condition, categorized by action type.
ActionsCountSummarySchema.x-zs-llm-description: Collection of action-type-to-count pairs within a condition. Contains actions_count array where each entry maps an action type to its configured count.

ModuleSpecificCountsResponseAllSchema.title: Module-Specific Counts Response (Alternate)

module_specific_count.description: Represents action counts broken down by CRM module.

ModuleSpecificCountsResponseAllSchema.description: Represents an alternate response model containing the workflow rule counts aggregated by CRM module.
ModuleSpecificCountsResponseAllSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Response from getModuleSpecificActionsCount. Contains module_specific_count array with per-module breakdowns of configured rules and actions.

ModuleSpecificActionsCountSchema.title: Module Workflow Rule Count

active_rules_configured.description: Represents number of currently active workflow rules configured.

total_rules_configured.description: Represents total number of workflow rules configured (active + inactive).

ModuleSpecificActionsCountSchema.description: Represents the workflow rule count details for a specific CRM module, including the number of active rules and total rules configured.
ModuleSpecificActionsCountSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Per-module rule count entry. Contains active_rules_configured, total_rules_configured, and module reference. Use to assess module-level capacity.

WorkflowRulesCountResponseSchema.title: Workflow Rules Quota Response
WorkflowRulesCountResponseSchema.description: Represents the response body containing the organization-level workflow rule quota and current usage counts.
WorkflowRulesCountResponseSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Response from getWorkflowRulesCount. Contains rules_count object with org-level limits: max rules, max actions per rule, max conditions per rule, max scheduled actions, and current usage counts.

WorkflowRuleUsageResponseSchema.title: Workflow Rule Usage Response

workflow_rules.description: Represents the array of workflow rule usage objects.

WorkflowRuleUsageResponseSchema.description: Represents the response body containing detailed execution usage metrics for one or more workflow rules within a queried date range.
WorkflowRuleUsageResponseSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Response from getWorkflowRuleUsage. Contains workflow_rules array with one entry holding per-condition usage metrics including success/failure counts and email engagement stats.

WorkflowConditionUsageSummarySchema.title: Workflow Condition Usage Summary

scheduled_actions.description: Represents the array of scheduled action groups configured for this condition.

usage_count.description: Represents the total number of times the actions in this condition were executed.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the WorkflowConditionUsageSummary within the workflow rule.

WorkflowConditionUsageSummarySchema.description: Represents the execution usage summary for a single workflow rule condition, including total execution count and breakdowns for instant and scheduled action groups.
WorkflowConditionUsageSummarySchema.x-zs-llm-description: Per-condition usage metrics. Contains instant_actions (list of action metrics), scheduled_actions (grouped action metrics), usage_count (total executions), and condition id.

WorkflowConditionUsageWithTaggedInstantA.title: Workflow Condition Usage With Tagged Instant Actions

scheduled_actions.description: Represents the list of scheduled action groups for a workflow rule, each group containing the actions and their execution usage metrics.

usage_count.description: Represents the total number of times the actions in this condition were executed.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the WorkflowConditionUsageWithTaggedInstantActions within the workflow rule.

WorkflowConditionUsageWithTaggedInstantA.description: Represents the usage summary for a workflow rule condition where instant actions include tag-based metrics, along with scheduled action group data.
WorkflowConditionUsageWithTaggedInstantA.x-zs-llm-description: Variant of condition usage where instant actions include tag_id for tracking tagged action performance. Same structure as WorkflowConditionUsageSummarySchema but with tag metadata on each action.

InstantActionsUsageWithTagsSchema.title: Instant Actions Usage With Tags

actions.description: Represents the array of action usage detail objects, including those associated with tags, for the instant actions configured in this condition.

InstantActionsUsageWithTagsSchema.description: Represents a container for instant action usage details that include tag-based metrics, grouped within a workflow rule condition.
InstantActionsUsageWithTagsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Container for tagged instant action usage metrics. Contains actions array where each entry includes tag_id alongside success/failure counts.

TaggedActionUsageMetricsSchema.title: Tagged Action Usage Metrics

name.description: Represents the display name of the workflow rule or its associated tagged action.

success_count.description: Represents the total number of successful executions recorded for this tagged action within the queried date range.

tag_id.description: Represents the unique ID of the tag associated with this action.

failure_count.description: Represents the total number of failed executions recorded for this tagged action within the queried date range.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the TaggedActionUsageMetrics within the workflow rule.

type.description: Represents the category of tagged workflow action executed by the rule.

associated_time.description: Represents the ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when this tagged action was last associated with or modified on a workflow rule.

TaggedActionUsageMetricsSchema.description: Represents usage metrics for a single tagged workflow action, including its identifier, tag ID, action type, and success and failure counts.
TaggedActionUsageMetricsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Individual action usage entry with tag association. Contains name, type, id, tag_id, success_count, failure_count, and associated_time.

ScheduledActionsForWorkflowUsageSchema.description: Represents the list of scheduled action groups for a workflow rule, each group containing the actions and their execution usage metrics.
ScheduledActionsForWorkflowUsageSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Container for scheduled action usage groups in the rule usage response. Lists action groups by their scheduled delay.

InstantActionsUsageListSchema.title: Instant Actions Usage List

actions.description: Represents the array of action usage detail objects for the instant actions configured in this condition.

InstantActionsUsageListSchema.description: Represents a container for the list of instant action usage detail objects associated with a workflow rule condition.
InstantActionsUsageListSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Container for instant action usage metrics without tag information. Contains actions array with per-action success/failure/queue counts.

ScheduledActionsUsageGroupSchema.title: Scheduled Actions Usage Group

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the ScheduledActionsUsageGroup within the workflow rule.

actions.description: Represents the array of action usage detail objects within this scheduled action group.

ScheduledActionsUsageGroupSchema.description: Represents a single scheduled action group within a workflow rule, containing the group ID and usage metrics for each action in the group.
ScheduledActionsUsageGroupSchema.x-zs-llm-description: A scheduled action group in usage. Contains group id and actions array with per-action execution metrics.

QueuedActionUsageMetricsSchema.title: Queued Action Usage Metrics

queue_count.description: Represents the number of executions currently queued and pending for this action.

name.description: Represents the display name of the workflow rule or its associated queued action as configured in Zoho CRM.

success_count.description: Represents the total number of successful executions recorded for this queued action within the queried date range.

failure_count.description: Represents the total number of failed executions recorded for this queued action within the queried date range.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the QueuedActionUsageMetrics within the workflow rule.

type.description: Represents the category of queued workflow action. Possible values include **email_notifications**, **field_updates**, **tasks**, **webhooks**, **functions**, **assign_owner**, **add_tags**, **remove_tags**, **create_record**, **add_meeting**, **schedule_call**, and **convert**.

associated_time.description: Represents the ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when this queued action was last associated with or modified on a workflow rule.
