QueuedActionUsageMetricsSchema.description: Represents usage metrics for a single queued workflow action, including success, failure, and queue counts within a queried date range.
QueuedActionUsageMetricsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Action usage entry with queue tracking. Contains queue_count (pending executions), success_count, failure_count, related_details (email engagement if applicable), name, id, type, and associated_time.

EmailEngagementMetricsSchema.title: Email Engagement Metrics

bulk_mail.description: Represents number of bulk email messages sent.

unopened.description: Represents number of emails not opened by recipients.

sent_percentage.description: Represents percentage of emails successfully sent out of total attempted.

opened.description: Represents number of emails opened by recipients.

delivered.description: Represents number of emails successfully delivered.

unsent.description: Represents number of emails that failed to send.

bounced.description: Represents number of emails that bounced back.

clicked.description: Represents number of emails where recipients clicked a link.

sent.description: Represents total number of emails sent.

EmailEngagementMetricsSchema.description: Represents email engagement metrics for an email notification action, including sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, and unsent counts.
EmailEngagementMetricsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Email-specific engagement stats within action usage. Contains sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsent, unopened counts, sent_percentage, and bulk_mail flag. Only populated for email_notifications actions.

ActionUsageMetricsSchema.title: Action Usage Metrics

name.description: Represents the display name of the workflow rule or its associated action as configured in Zoho CRM.

success_count.description: Represents the total number of successful executions recorded for this action within the queried date range.

failure_count.description: Represents the total number of failed executions recorded for this action within the queried date range.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the workflow action.

type.description: Represents the category of workflow action executed by the rule.

associated_time.description: Represents the ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when this action was last associated with or modified on a workflow rule.

ActionUsageMetricsSchema.description: Represents usage metrics for a single workflow action, including its identifier, display name, action type, execution success and failure counts within a queried date range, and the timestamp of its last association.
ActionUsageMetricsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Basic action usage entry without queue or email details. Contains name, type, id, success_count, failure_count, and associated_time.

ReorderWorkflowRulesRequestSchema.title: Reorder Workflow Rules Request V2
ReorderWorkflowRulesRequestSchema.description: Represents the request body for reordering workflow rules, containing the new position assignments for each rule.
ReorderWorkflowRulesRequestSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Request body for reorderWorkflowRules. Contains reorder array with rule IDs in the desired execution sequence. All active rules for the target module must be included.

per_page.description: Represents the number of records returned per page.

count.description: Represents the total number of records matching the query.

page.description: Represents the current page number in the paginated response.

more_records.description: Indicates whether more records exist beyond the current page.

InfoNestedSchema.description: Represents the pagination metadata included in list response payloads, including the current page, records per page, total count, and whether more records exist.
InfoNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Pagination metadata in list responses. Contains per_page (items per page), count (items in current page), page (current page number), more_records (boolean  -  whether additional pages exist). Use more_records to determine if next page should be fetched.

name.description: Represents the display name of the AssignOwner action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the AssignOwner action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

AssignOwnerActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that assigns or reassigns the record owner when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
AssignOwnerActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='assign_owner'. Requires module and assign_to array (1-5 entries). assign_to discriminates on type: user/role/group/profile/assignment_rule need resource.id; merge_field needs details.api_name (user-type field); criteria needs criteria array. Optional: notify (trigger notification), related_records (transfer child record ownership), apply_assignment_threshold.

name.description: Represents the display name of the CreateRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the CreateRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

CreateRecordActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that creates a new record in a specified CRM module when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
CreateRecordActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='create_record'. Creates a record in a specified module (NOT Tasks/Events/Calls  -  use tasks/add_meeting/schedule_call). Requires module, layout, and field_mappings (1-25 entries, must include all mandatory fields). Each mapping: {field, type, value} with type discriminating: static (literal), merge_field (${!Module.Field} token), execution_time (date offset), composite (multi-value).

name.description: Represents the display name of the add-meeting action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the add-meeting action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this add-meeting action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. When this field is provided with a null value, the platform interprets it as a deletion signal and removes the action from the rules action list.

AddMeetingActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that schedules a meeting when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
AddMeetingActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='add_meeting'. Creates an Event record. Requires module (Events), layout, field_mappings (must include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({value, period}  -  not when All_Day=true), and host_unavailable (either assign_record_owner_as_host:true or assign_task:{id}). Optional: apply_restriction.

name.description: Represents the display name of the ScheduleCall action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the ScheduleCall action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

ScheduleCallActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that schedules a call activity on the triggering record when the workflow rule condition is met.
ScheduleCallActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='schedule_call'. Creates a Calls record. Requires module (Calls), layout, and field_mappings (must include Subject). Key fields: Subject, Call_Purpose, Call_Type, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Optional: apply_restriction.

name.description: Represents the display name of the add-tags action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the add-tags action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this add-tags action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. When this field is provided with a null value, the platform interprets it as a deletion signal and removes the action from the rules action list.

AddTagsActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that adds pre-existing tags to the triggering record when the workflow rule condition is met.
AddTagsActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='add_tags'. Adds pre-existing tags to the triggering record. Requires details.tags array (1-10 entries, each {id, name}). Optional: over_write (bool  -  true replaces all existing tags). Cannot coexist with convert action on Leads. Tags must be pre-created via getTags/POST.

name.description: Represents the display name of the RemoveTags action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the RemoveTags action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

RemoveTagsActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that removes one or more tags from the triggering record when the workflow rule condition is met.
RemoveTagsActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='remove_tags'. Removes specified tags from the triggering record. Requires details.tags (1-10 entries, each {id, name}). Cannot coexist with convert on Leads. Invalid if same rule has add_tags with over_write=true. Tags must already exist on the record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Convert action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Convert action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

ConvertActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that converts a record to another module type, such as converting a lead to a contact, account, and deal.
ConvertActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='convert'. Converts records across modules: Leads->Contacts+Accounts+Deals, Quotes->SalesOrders/Invoices, SalesOrders->Invoices. Limit 1 per rule. Requires criteria_details.criteria to be non-null. For Leads: add_to_existing_contact, add_to_existing_account, change_owner are mandatory. For Quotes/SalesOrders: convert_to is mandatory. No scheduled actions allowed with convert.

name.description: Represents the display name of the CreateConnectedRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the CreateConnectedRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

CreateConnectedRecordActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that creates a connected record in a child module when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
CreateConnectedRecordActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='create_connected_record'. Same structure as create_record but targets a connected-record child module. Limit 1/rule. Not for Notes, Rebuy, or Competitor Mentions. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Needs module, layout, and field_mappings.

name.description: Represents the display name of the ChatNotification action. This field is required.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the ChatNotification action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

ChatNotificationActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that sends a chat notification to an integrated chat service, such as Slack or Zoho Cliq, when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
ChatNotificationActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action for chat integrations: type=slack_notifications|cliq_notifications|cisco_notifications|google_chat_notifications|microsoft_teams_notifications. Limit 1 per type per rule. Requires name, details.message (supports ${Module.Field} merge tokens), and details.notify_to ({type: user|channel|fields} with appropriate sub-fields).

name.description: Represents the display name of the Circuits action. This field is required.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Circuits action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

CircuitsActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that executes a Zoho Circuits workflow when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
CircuitsActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='circuits'. Executes a Zoho Circuits workflow. Limit 1/rule. Requires name, details.circuit_id (Zoho Circuits circuit identifier). Verify 'circuits' is enabled for the module via getWorkflowConfigurations before using.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Zoho Flow action. This field is required.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Zoho Flow action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this Zoho Flow action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

ZohoFlowActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that triggers a Zoho Flow workflow when the workflow rule condition is met.
ZohoFlowActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='flow'. Triggers a Zoho Flow custom action. Limit 1/rule. Requires name, details.custom_action_id and details.custom_action_name (obtained from getCustomActions filtered by service_type='zoho_flow', component_type='workflow'). Verify 'flow' is enabled via getWorkflowConfigurations.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Social action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Social action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

SocialActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that publishes a post to a social network such as Facebook or Twitter when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
SocialActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline social action for Facebook (comment_to_post, reply_to_comment, like_to_comment, reply_to_message) or Twitter (retweet, reply_to_tweet). Available only with matching social triggers (fb_* or tw_*). Limit 1 per type per rule. details.content required for comment/reply types, not needed for like/retweet.

name.description: Represents the display name of the EmailCreateRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the EmailCreateRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

EmailCreateRecordActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that creates a record via an email-based trigger, applicable to modules such as Leads or Contacts.
EmailCreateRecordActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='create_record_email'. Creates a Leads or Contacts record via email. Limit 1/rule. Requires details.module (api_name: 'Leads' or 'Contacts') and details.field_mappings (exactly 1 entry specifying owner assignment: field with value.type user|role|group|country and value.resource.id).

WorkflowSimpleFilterCriterion.description: Represents a simple filter criterion for workflow rule queries, specifying the field API name, comparator, and value to match.
WorkflowSimpleFilterCriterion.x-zs-llm-description: Single filter criterion in a workflow criteria array. Required: field ({api_name, id}), comparator (equal, not_equal, like, starts_with, etc.), value. Special: '${ANYVALUE}' comparator supported only in field_update triggers to match any value change. Type field distinguishes value source: 'value' (literal), 'merge_field' (runtime token), 'pre_defined' (system), 'field' (other field comparison).

group.description: Represents the array of filter conditions to be evaluated together using the specified logical operator.

WorkflowGroupedFilterCriterion.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple simple filter conditions evaluated together using a logical operator such as AND or OR.
WorkflowGroupedFilterCriterion.x-zs-llm-description: Grouped filter criterion containing multiple WorkflowSimpleFilterCriterion items joined by group_operator (AND/OR). Use for complex multi-field conditions. The group array holds the individual criteria and group_operator defines their logical relationship.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field used for filter operations.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

WorkflowRulesFilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

BusinessHoursSuccessResponseResponse.description: Standard success response for business hours operations

FieldMappingForReadItem.description: Field mapping item for read operations.

FieldMappingForWriteItem.description: Field mapping item for write operations.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

WorkflowRulesSimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

WorkflowRulesSimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

WorkflowRulesAutomationModuleRef.title: Automation Module Reference

api_name.description: API name of the module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Vendors).

id.description: Unique module ID (19-digit format). Always use the full ID as returned by GET /settings/modules - truncated or shortened IDs return INVALID_DATA ('the tabId given seems to be invalid'). Optional in requests if api_name is provided; always present in responses.

WorkflowRulesAutomationModuleRef.description: PURPOSE: Module reference used across non-associate actions. At least one of api_name or id required (EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither). If both given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). GET /settings/modules to discover. Always use full 19-digit module ID.
WorkflowRulesAutomationModuleRef.x-zs-llm-description: Module reference for action targeting. At least one of api_name or id required  EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither is present. If both provided and they refer to different modules  AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getModules. Used in most non-associate action details to specify where the action operates.

AutomationAssignOwnerResource.title: Assign Owner Resource

id.description: Unique identifier of the target entity. Obtain from the corresponding API: GET /settings/users (for user), GET /settings/roles (for role), GET /settings/user_groups (for group), GET /settings/automation/assignment_rules (for assignment_rule), or GET /settings/profiles (for profile).

name.description: Display name of the target entity. Optional in POST/PUT requests (server resolves from id); always present in GET responses.

AutomationAssignOwnerResource.description: PURPOSE: Resource reference for assign_to entry. MANDATORY: id (string). OPTIONAL: name, type. Obtain from GET /settings/users (user), /settings/roles (role), /settings/user_groups (group), /settings/automation/assignment_rules (assignment_rule), /settings/profiles (profile). If both id and name given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING).
AutomationAssignOwnerResource.x-zs-llm-description: Resource reference within an assign_to entry. id is mandatory (DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING if absent). name is optional (server resolves from id). type indicates resource kind when present. Obtain IDs from: getUsers (user), getRoles (role), getUserGroups (group), getAssignmentRules (assignment_rule), getProfiles (profile).

AutomationAssignToResourceEntry.title: Assign To Resource Entry

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

details.description: Always null for resource-based assignments. Present in GET responses for schema consistency with other assign_to types.

AutomationAssignToResourceEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for resource-based ownership. MANDATORY: type (user|role|group|assignment_rule|profile), resource ({id, name}). For type=profile: associated_to must be 'team_profile'. For round-robin: use multiple entries of type=user.
AutomationAssignToResourceEntry.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership is assigned to a specific resource. type selects the resource kind: user, role, group, assignment_rule, or profile. resource object provides the target's id and optionally name. For profile type: associated_to must be 'team_profile'. Returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING if resource is omitted.

AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry.title: Assign To Merge Field Entry

resource.description: Always null for merge field assignments. The owner is resolved dynamically from the merge field at execution time.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for merge-field-based ownership. Resolves to a user at execution time from a user-type field. MANDATORY: type (const 'merge_field'), details.api_name (merge field token e.g., '${!Leads.Created_By}'). Field must be data_type=ownerlookup or userlookup. GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover.
AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership resolves at runtime from a user-type lookup field on the trigger record. type must be 'merge_field'. details.api_name specifies the field (e.g., a custom user lookup). The field must be a user-type field  non-user fields return INVALID_DATA.

WorkflowRulesSimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

WorkflowRulesSimpleFilterCriterionValueG.description:
Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

WorkflowRulesSimpleFilterCriterionValueD.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

id.description: Represents unique identifier for the scheduled action.

actions.description: Represents the list of action execution records within this scheduled action group.

ScheduledActionsForWorkflowUsageSchemaIt.description: Represents a scheduled action group configured for the workflow rule, including its execute-after delay and the list of actions within the group.

include_objects.description: Indicates whether records with matching related records are included in the results.

RecordCrossFiltersRequestItem.description: Represents a single cross-filter object that filters records based on the presence or absence of related module records matching the specified criteria.

WorkflowRulesEqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

WorkflowRulesNotEqualFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

WorkflowRulesEqualityFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

WorkflowRulesTextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

WorkflowRulesOrderingFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

WorkflowRulesBetweenFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

WorkflowRulesSetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

WorkflowRulesMultiSelectLookupFilterCrit.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

WorkflowRulesSimpleFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

WorkflowRulesGroupedFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

WorkflowRulesFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry.title: Assign To Criteria Entry

resource.description: Always null for criteria-based assignments. The owner is determined by the criteria evaluation logic.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for criteria-based ownership. Evaluates filter criteria against the triggering record at execution time. MANDATORY: type (const 'criteria'), details.criteria (filter condition - simple or grouped with AND/OR). Criteria fields must reference valid trigger module fields - GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.
AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership is determined by evaluating filter criteria at runtime. type must be 'criteria'. criteria array defines the conditions  the first user matching all criteria becomes the owner. If no user matches, the action silently skips assignment.

AutomationRelatedRecord.title: Automation Related Record

id.description: Unique identifier of the related module. This is the module ID corresponding to the api_name.

AutomationRelatedRecord.description: Identifies a related module whose open records' ownership should be transferred alongside the parent record. Used by assign_owner actions, field_updates (Owner field), and convert actions (change_owner.related_modules). Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules and actions. Contacts is available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts, and for convert when converting Leads. Deals is available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts or Contacts, and for convert when converting Leads (requires create_deal=true).
AutomationRelatedRecord.x-zs-llm-description: Identifies a related module whose open records should also change ownership when the parent record's owner changes. Used by assign_owner (related_records array) and convert (change_owner.related_modules). Requires api_name and/or id to identify the child module. Valid modules depend on parent: for Leads  Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals.

AutomationLookupFieldRef.title: Automation Lookup Field Reference

api_name.description: API name of the lookup field (e.g., Lookup_1_same, Lookup_2_cont).

id.description: Unique field ID of the lookup field.

AutomationLookupFieldRef.description: Identifies a lookup field that links the workflow rule's trigger module to the target module of a cross-module action. For example, if the trigger module is Leads and the assign owner action targets Contacts, the lookup_field identifies which lookup field on Leads points to Contacts (e.g., Lookup_2_cont).
AutomationLookupFieldRef.x-zs-llm-description: Identifies a lookup field linking the rule's trigger module to an action's target module. Required for cross-module field_updates (via related_details.lookup_field) and cross-module assign_owner (when targeting a different module). Both api_name and id should refer to the same lookup field  mismatch returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getFields filtered by field_type=lookup.

AutomationAssignOwnerDetails.title: Automation Assign Owner Details

assign_to.description: Specifies how the new owner is determined. Each entry defines an assignment method  - a specific user, role, group, assignment rule, profile, merge field, or criteria-based filter. For round-robin assignment across multiple users, provide multiple entries of type=user. For criteria-based assignment, provide a single entry of type=criteria with filter conditions.

related_records.description: Related modules whose open record ownership should also be transferred when the parent record is reassigned. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional modules depend on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Null when no related modules are selected for ownership transfer.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new owner when the record is reassigned. When true, the newly assigned owner receives an email informing them of the ownership change.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) when assigning ownership. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before applying the assignment. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

user_availability_based_on.description: Restricts assignment to users who are currently available. When set to ["online_status"], only users logged in to the Zoho CRM web interface are eligible for assignment. If the selected user is offline, the assignment is skipped or deferred. Null means no availability check is applied.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this assign owner action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST or PUT requests.

AutomationAssignOwnerDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for assign_owner action. Assigns/reassigns record owner via user, role, group, profile, assignment_rule, merge_field, or criteria. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id} - must match trigger module), assign_to (array 1-5 entries). OPTIONAL: notify (bool), related_records ([{api_name, id}] - Tasks/Calls/Events), apply_assignment_threshold (bool), user_availability_based_on, lookup_field (for cross-module). EXAMPLE: {"module": {"api_name": "Leads", "id": "111111000000000175"}, "assign_to": [{"type": "user", "resource": {"id": "111111000000050001", "name": "John"}}], "notify": true}
AutomationAssignOwnerDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='assign_owner'. assign_to array (1-5 entries) discriminates on type field: user/role/group/profile/assignment_rule require resource.id; merge_field requires details.api_name (user-type lookup field); criteria requires a criteria array evaluated at runtime. Optional: notify (bool), related_records (transfer child ownership), apply_assignment_threshold (bool). Module reference required.

WorkflowRulesAutomationLayoutRef.title: Automation Layout Reference

id.description: Unique layout ID. Required. Obtain from GET /settings/layouts?module={module_api_name}.

name.description: Display name of the layout. Optional in requests; present in GET responses.

display_label.description: Human-readable label of the layout. Present in GET responses.

WorkflowRulesAutomationLayoutRef.description: PURPOSE: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call actions. MANDATORY: id (string). Determines field availability and validation rules. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} to discover.
WorkflowRulesAutomationLayoutRef.x-zs-llm-description: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call. id is mandatory  determines which fields are available and required for the target module. Obtain from getLayouts?module={api_name}. Wrong layout returns INVALID_DATA.

WorkflowRulesAutomationFieldAttributes.title: Automation Field Attributes

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the target field in the destination module — for example, Subject, Due_Date, or Owner — used to identify the field receiving the mapped value within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, and convert.

id.description: Represents the numeric identifier of the target CRM field. Used in conjunction with the field's API name, both of which must resolve to the same field for a mapping to be valid.

WorkflowRulesAutomationFieldAttributes.description: Identifies the target CRM field to which a mapping value is applied within an automation rule. The api_name and ID properties must both be supplied and must refer to the same field; a mismatch between the two causes an AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING error. Available fields for a given module can be discovered via GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.
WorkflowRulesAutomationFieldAttributes.x-zs-llm-description: Target field identifier. Both api_name and id are mandatory  providing only one still works but both should be given for reliability. If both provided and they refer to different fields: AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getFields?module={module_api_name}. The field must be writable and compatible with mapping type.

include_objects.description: Indicates whether records with matching related records are included in the results.

CrossFiltersRequestItem.description: Represents a single cross-filter object that filters records based on the presence or absence of related module records matching the specified criteria.

items.description: A single picklist option string to include in the multi-select field value. Each entry corresponds to one selectable option as defined for the target field in Zoho CRM.

WorkflowRulesStaticArrayValue.description: Represents an array of string values used as the static value for multiselectpicklist fields, where each element corresponds to an available picklist option. Valid option labels are retrievable from the GET /settings/fields endpoint filtered by data_type=multiselectpicklist.
WorkflowRulesStaticArrayValue.x-zs-llm-description: Array value for type=static on multiselect_picklist fields. Each element must match an available picklist option. Discover valid options from getFields for the target module. Invalid options return INVALID_DATA.

WorkflowRulesStaticObjectValue.title: Static Object Value

id.description: The system identifier of the referenced entity, such as a user or layout record. This value drives entity resolution by the automation engine and must be provided when the target field references an entity.

name.description: The display name of the referenced entity, such as a user full name or a layout label. When omitted from a request payload, the server resolves and populates this property from the supplied ID. The property is present in all GET responses.

WorkflowRulesStaticObjectValue.description: Represents an object value used as the static value for ownerlookup and layout fields, containing an ID that identifies the target user or layout and an optional name that the server resolves from the ID when not supplied. Typically used to assign record ownership by providing the user ID.
WorkflowRulesStaticObjectValue.x-zs-llm-description: Object value for type=static on ownerlookup and layout fields. id is mandatory (user ID or layout ID). name is optional server resolves from id. Use getUsers for owner IDs, getLayouts for layout IDs.

WorkflowRulesStaticFieldMapping.title: Static Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

WorkflowRulesStaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.
WorkflowRulesStaticFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='static' mapping. Value is used as-is without runtime resolution. NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields (use execution_time  static returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). NOT for unique fields or formula fields. Value structure depends on field data_type: string for most fields, array for multiselect_picklist, object for ownerlookup/layout.

include_objects.description: Indicates whether records with matching related records were included in the filtered results.

CrossFiltersResponseItem.description: Represents a single cross-filter object returned in the response, containing the relationship reference, filter criteria, and inclusion flag.

WorkflowRulesMergeFieldMapping.title: Merge Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

value.description: Represents the string value carried by a merge_field mapping, containing one or more runtime-resolved token references. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), lookup traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Tokens may be combined with surrounding text for multi-line field targets. Fields that hold a single typed value such as email or URL accept exactly one token.

allow_agent_user.description:
Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values:
**true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users.
**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

WorkflowRulesMergeFieldMapping.description: Represents a merge_field-type mapping whose value is resolved at execution time by substituting token references with live field data. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Applies to text-based fields such as Subject, Description, and custom text fields. Targeting owner or lookup fields with this type produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error; those fields require a static mapping using an object with a numeric identifier and an optional name. Multiple tokens may be chained with surrounding text for multi-line fields, while single-value fields such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
WorkflowRulesMergeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='merge_field' mapping. Value contains ${!Module.Field} tokens resolved at execution time. ONLY for text-based fields (Subject, Description, etc.)  using on date/number/picklist fields returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Supports lookup traversal: ${!Module.Lookup.Field}. Multi-module not supported.

WorkflowRulesExecutionTimeValue.title: Execution Time Value

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

WorkflowRulesExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.
WorkflowRulesExecutionTimeValue.x-zs-llm-description: Offset computation object for date/datetime/ALARM fields. Required fields: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (string integer  quantity), trigger_field (merge-field token like ${!Leads.Created_Time} or ${CURRENTTIME}). Optional: sign ('positive' for after, 'negative' for before  default varies by context). Missing required fields return DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING.

WorkflowRulesExecutionTimeFieldMapping.title: Execution Time Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

WorkflowRulesExecutionTimeFieldMapping.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.
WorkflowRulesExecutionTimeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='execution_time' mapping. REQUIRED for Date, DateTime, and ALARM field types (static/merge_field on these returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Computes value as offset from trigger_field. Value object needs: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (integer as string), trigger_field (merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}), sign (for before/after offset).

WorkflowRulesCompositeFieldMapping.title: Composite Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

WorkflowRulesCompositeFieldMapping.description: Represents a composite-type field mapping used exclusively for the Participants field in the Events module via the add_meeting action. The value carries a structured object that encodes participant data and is not applicable to any other field or automation action type.
WorkflowRulesCompositeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='composite' mapping. Used ONLY for the Participants field in Events module (add_meeting action). Value is a structured object representing multiple participant entries. Cannot be used on other field types  returns NOT_ALLOWED.

WorkflowRulesAutomationFieldMappings.title: Automation Field Mappings

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

allow_agent_user.description:
Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values:
**true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users.
**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

WorkflowRulesAutomationFieldMappings.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping used within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. Each mapping identifies a target field via api_name or ID, declares a type discriminator that determines value interpretation, and supplies a value whose shape varies by type: static supplies a literal value, merge_field supplies a runtime-resolved token string, execution_time supplies a date or datetime offset object, and composite supplies structured participant data for the Events Participants field. The field_mappings array must include all fields the target module requires; omitting any produces a REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND error.
WorkflowRulesAutomationFieldMappings.x-zs-llm-description: A single field-to-value mapping entry used in create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, and workflow task actions. Each entry targets one field and assigns a typed value. The type field discriminates the value structure: static (literal), merge_field (runtime token), execution_time (date offset), composite (multi-value). field identifies the target, type selects the value schema, value provides the data.

AutomationCreateRecordDetails.title: Automation Create Record Details

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new record. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Last_Name"}, "type": "static", "value": "Test"}. Must include all mandatory fields (system_mandatory=true or api_mandatory=true from GET /settings/layouts?module={module}) - missing ones cause REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist, phone, number fields; NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH) or unique fields (INVALID_DATA, check unique=true in GET /settings/fields). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Company} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner fields (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes; sign required for datetime fields.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this create record action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationCreateRecordDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_record action. Creates a record in a module with field values from static data, merge fields, or execution-time refs. NOT for Tasks/Events/Calls (use tasks, add_meeting, schedule_call). PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/modules for id. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include all mandatory fields). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). EXAMPLE: {"module": {"api_name": "Contacts", "id": "111111000000000129"}, "layout": {"id": "111111000000000403"}, "field_mappings": [{"field": {"api_name": "Last_Name"}, "type": "merge_field", "value": "${!Leads.Last_Name}"}]}
AutomationCreateRecordDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='create_record'. Creates a record in a module (NOT Tasks/Events/Calls  use dedicated action types). Requires module ({api_name, id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (1-25 entries covering all mandatory fields). Each mapping has field reference, type (static|merge_field|execution_time|composite), and typed value. Optional: apply_restriction (bool).

field_mappings.description: REQUIRED. Field mapping array (1-25 entries). Use GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover field api_name and id. All mandatory fields for the target module/layout must be included.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

AutomationCreateConnectedRecordDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_connected_record action. Same as create_record but module must be a connected-record child of the rule's module. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Not for Notes, Rebuy, Competitor Mentions. Limit: 1/rule. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id} of child), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include all mandatory fields). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool).
AutomationCreateConnectedRecordDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='create_connected_record'. Same structure as create_record but module must be a connected-record child. Requires module, layout, field_mappings. Not for Notes, Rebuy, or Competitor Mentions. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Limit 1/rule.

AutomationMeetingDuration.title: Automation Meeting Duration
AutomationMeetingDuration.description: PURPOSE: Meeting duration for add_meeting. MANDATORY unless All_Day=true. REQUIRED: unit (integer - quantity), period (string - 'hours' or 'minutes'). Must be a JSON object (not int/string - INVALID_DATA). Omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND. If All_Day=true and provided, returns INVALID_DATA (field1/field2 conflict). EXAMPLE: {"unit": 1, "period": "hours"}
AutomationMeetingDuration.x-zs-llm-description: Duration config for add_meeting. Required when All_Day is not true. unit is the quantity (integer), period is the time unit ('hours', 'minutes', or 'days'). Omit entirely when mapping All_Day=true (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH if both present).

AutomationHostUnavailable.title: Automation Host Unavailable

assign_record_owner_as_host.description: When true, the record owner is automatically assigned as the host/caller if the originally designated host is unavailable. Mutually exclusive with assign_task.

AutomationHostUnavailable.description: PURPOSE: Fallback when meeting host or caller is unavailable. Exactly ONE must be specified: assign_record_owner_as_host (bool) OR assign_task ({id}). Both = INVALID_DATA. Neither = EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.
AutomationHostUnavailable.x-zs-llm-description: Fallback config when the meeting host or caller is unavailable. Exactly ONE option must be set: assign_record_owner_as_host (bool  record owner becomes host) OR assign_task ({id}  delegates to an existing task entity). Setting both or neither returns INVALID_DATA.

AutomationAddMeetingDetails.title: Automation Add Meeting Details

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Event. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Event_Title"}, "type": "static", "value": "Meeting"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Events. Common fields: Event_Title, Start_DateTime, All_Day, Participants (composite type), Remind_At. End_DateTime is auto-computed from Start_DateTime + meeting_duration - do NOT provide it. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Company} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Start_DateTime and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes. When All_Day=true, period must be "days" and omit meeting_duration.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Event record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this add meeting action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationAddMeetingDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for add_meeting action. Creates an Event record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Events for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Events for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Events', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({unit: int, period: 'hours'|'minutes'} - NOT when All_Day=true), host_unavailable ({assign_record_owner_as_host: true} or {assign_task: {id}}). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool).
AutomationAddMeetingDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='add_meeting'. Creates an Event record. Requires module (Events), layout, field_mappings (must include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({unit, period}  omit when All_Day=true), host_unavailable (exactly one of: assign_record_owner_as_host=true OR assign_task={id}). Optional: apply_restriction.

WorkflowRulesAutomationScheduleCallDetai.title: Automation Schedule Call Details

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Call. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Subject"}, "type": "static", "value": "Follow-up"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. Call_Type is system-mandatory (values: "Outbound", "Inbound", "Missed") - omitting returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Common fields: Subject, Call_Type, Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Phone} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Call_Start_Time and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Call record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this schedule call action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

WorkflowRulesAutomationScheduleCallDetai.description: PURPOSE: Details object for schedule_call action. Creates a Call record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Calls for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Calls', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Subject, Call_Type). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). KEY FIELDS: Subject, Call_Type ('Outbound'|'Inbound'|'Missed'), Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At.
WorkflowRulesAutomationScheduleCallDetai.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='schedule_call'. Creates a Calls record. Requires module (Calls), layout, field_mappings (must include Subject). Key fields: Subject, Call_Purpose, Call_Type, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Same field_mapping structure as create_record. Optional: apply_restriction.

AutomationTagRef.title: Automation Tag Reference

id.description: Unique identifier of the tag. Obtain from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If provided alone, the tag is resolved by ID. If both id and name are provided, they must resolve to the same tag.

name.description: Name of the tag. Obtain from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If provided alone, the tag is resolved by name. Must match an existing tag  - providing a non-existent name returns INVALID_DATA. Max 25 characters, cannot contain <, >, commas, or emojis.

color_code.description: Hex color code of the tag (e.g., '#879BFC'). Optional in requests; present in GET responses. Allowed values: #F17574, #F48435, #E7A826, #A8C026, #63C57E, #1DB9B4, #57B1FD, #879BFC, #D297EE, #FD87BD, #969696, #658BA8, #B88562.

AutomationTagRef.description: PURPOSE: Tag reference for add_tags/remove_tags. Tags must pre-exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list, POST to create. MANDATORY: id, name. Both must resolve to same tag (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING if mismatch). Non-existent = INVALID_DATA. Limits: 100 tags/module, 10 tags/record, name max 25 chars.
AutomationTagRef.x-zs-llm-description: Tag reference for add_tags/remove_tags. Both id and name are mandatory  missing either returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND. Tags must pre-exist. Discover via getTags?module={api_name}, create via POST /settings/tags. Invalid tag id returns INVALID_DATA.

AutomationAddTagsDetails.title: Automation Add Tags Details

over_write.description: Whether to overwrite all existing tags on the record with the specified tags (true) or append to existing tags (false). Default is false. When set to true, any RemoveTags action in the same workflow rule becomes invalid and returns INVALID_DATA ('Remove tag not supported with Overwrite Add Tag').

tags.description: List of tags to add to the record. All tags must pre-exist in the org  - fetch available tags from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. To create new tags: POST /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If the list is empty after parsing, the API returns FAILURE ('Empty Tag'). If the tag count exceeds the edition limit, the API returns FAILURE ('Invalid Tag Count').

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this add tags action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationAddTagsDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for add_tags action. Adds pre-existing tags to the triggering record. PREREQUISITES: Tags must exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list, POST to create first. MANDATORY: tags (array 1-10, each {id, name}). OPTIONAL: over_write (bool, default false - true replaces ALL existing tags), module ({api_name, id}). CONSTRAINTS: Not allowed with convert on Leads (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). over_write=true + remove_tags in same rule = INVALID_DATA. Unsupported: Visits, Users, LinkingModules (NOT_ALLOWED).
AutomationAddTagsDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='add_tags'. Requires tags array (1-10, each {id, name}). Optional: over_write (true replaces all existing tags), module ({api_name, id}). Cannot coexist with convert on Leads. over_write=true + remove_tags in same rule = INVALID_DATA. Tags must pre-exist  discover via getTags or create via POST.

AutomationRemoveTagsDetails.title: Automation Remove Tags Details

tags.description: List of tags to remove from the record. All tags must pre-exist in the org  - fetch available tags from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If the list is empty after parsing, the API returns FAILURE ('Empty Tag'). If the tag count exceeds the edition limit, the API returns FAILURE ('Invalid Tag Count').

over_write.description: Present in GET responses. Its value is ignored for remove_tags actions.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this remove tags action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST or PUT requests.

AutomationRemoveTagsDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for remove_tags action. Removes tags from the triggering record. PREREQUISITES: Tags must exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list. MANDATORY: tags (array 1-10, each {id, name}). OPTIONAL: module ({api_name, id}). CONSTRAINTS: Not allowed with convert on Leads (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). If same rule has add_tags with over_write=true, this returns INVALID_DATA. Unsupported: Visits, Users, LinkingModules (NOT_ALLOWED). Note: over_write field is type-checked but its value is ignored for remove_tags.
AutomationRemoveTagsDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='remove_tags'. Requires tags array (1-10, each {id, name}). Optional: module ({api_name, id}). Cannot coexist with convert on Leads. Invalid if same rule has add_tags with over_write=true. Tags must already exist on the record for removal to have effect.

AutomationConvertChangeOwner.title: Automation Convert Change Owner

id.description: Unique user ID of the new owner. Obtain from GET /users. Must be an active user with permissions on the target modules.

name.description: Full name of the new owner. Optional  - present in GET responses for display purposes.

related_modules.description: List of target modules whose records should receive the new owner during conversion. Reuses the same related-record concept as assign_owner. For Leads conversion: Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals are valid. For Quotes/SalesOrders conversion: only Events, Calls, Tasks are valid.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the new owner for each converted module. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before assigning ownership.

AutomationConvertChangeOwner.description: PURPOSE: Owner assignment during convert action. MANDATORY: id (user ID from GET /users). OPTIONAL: name, related_modules ([{api_name, id}] - which converted modules get new owner), apply_assignment_threshold (bool). For Leads: related_modules can include Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals.
AutomationConvertChangeOwner.x-zs-llm-description: Owner configuration during convert action. id (user ID) is mandatory  specifies who receives ownership of converted records. Optional: name, related_modules (which converted childmodules get new owner  e.g., Events, Calls, Tasks for Leads), apply_assignment_threshold (enforce per-user record limits). Obtain user ID from getUsers.

AutomationConvertDetails.title: Automation Convert Details

add_to_existing_contact.description: MANDATORY for Leads conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Whether to link the converted record to an existing Contact instead of creating a new one. Only applicable for Leads module. When true, if a matching Contact exists (based on duplicate-check criteria), the Lead is merged into it rather than creating a new Contact. Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

add_to_existing_account.description: MANDATORY for Leads conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Whether to link the converted record to an existing Account instead of creating a new one. Only applicable for Leads module. When true, if a matching Account exists (based on Company name), the Lead is linked to it rather than creating a new Account. Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

WorkflowTasksStaticFieldMapping.title: Static Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

WorkflowTasksStaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.

WorkflowTasksExecutionTimeValue.title: Execution Time Value

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

WorkflowTasksExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.
WorkflowTasksExecutionTimeValue.x-zs-llm-description: Offset computation object for date/datetime/ALARM fields. Required fields: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (string integer  quantity), trigger_field (merge-field token like ${!Leads.Created_Time} or ${CURRENTTIME}). Optional: sign ('positive' for after, 'negative' for before  default varies by context). Missing required fields return DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING.

WorkflowTasksExecutionTimeFieldMapping.title: Execution Time Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

WorkflowTasksExecutionTimeFieldMapping.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.
WorkflowTasksExecutionTimeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='execution_time' mapping. REQUIRED for Date, DateTime, and ALARM field types (static/merge_field on these returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Computes value as offset from trigger_field. Value object needs: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (integer as string), trigger_field (merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}), sign (for before/after offset).

WorkflowTasksAutomationFieldMappings.title: Automation Field Mappings

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

allow_agent_user.description:
Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values:
**true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users.
**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

WorkflowTasksAutomationFieldMappings.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping used within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. Each mapping identifies a target field via api_name or ID, declares a type discriminator that determines value interpretation, and supplies a value whose shape varies by type: static supplies a literal value, merge_field supplies a runtime-resolved token string, execution_time supplies a date or datetime offset object, and composite supplies structured participant data for the Events Participants field. The field_mappings array must include all fields the target module requires; omitting any produces a REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND error.
WorkflowTasksAutomationFieldMappings.x-zs-llm-description: A single field-to-value mapping entry used in create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, and workflow task actions. Each entry targets one field and assigns a typed value. The type field discriminates the value structure: static (literal), merge_field (runtime token), execution_time (date offset), composite (multi-value). field identifies the target, type selects the value schema, value provides the data.

Represents the current status of the user in the Zoho CRM organization.

active - The user is active and can access the CRM.
